\subsection*{\interlinepenalty=150\relax 2026-09-05 (CLVI) (all-place Tate / finite-carrier / Rankin audit graduates as \texttt{v1021}; isolated suite delta $1013\to1014$, isolated ledger-record delta $1177\to1178$, one new row \texttt{PRIME.ALLPLACE.TATE.INTERSECTION.01}~\mO; NO marker move; Python-only / Wolfram mirror deferred).  \texttt{v1021\_\allowbreak all\_\allowbreak place\_\allowbreak tate\_\allowbreak rank\_\allowbreak audit.py} ($23/23$): exact scalar Tate projector and good-place tensor/End splittings; the Tate identity remains inertia-fixed at $p=2$; completed zeta is $2\xi(u)/(u(u-1))$, not $\xi(u)$; the symmetric-square prime coefficient is $a_p^2-p^3$, not $a_p^2-2p^3$.  Conditional on the cited external strict-floor premise, rank--nullity excludes representing the complete window form as one exact linear pullback through a fixed finite carrier; nonlinear methods, growing finite discretizations and direct limits are not excluded.  An exact sparse counterexample corrects the historical Rankin inference: $A(X)=O(X^q)$ with nonnegative coefficients does not imply $b_n=O(n^{q-1+\varepsilon})$, and a maximum fitted on a finite window makes its same-window inequality tautological.  Rankin's actual 1939 argument uses a quantitative summatory error term, not a pole and positivity alone.  The correction of record is placed outside the preserved historical docstrings of \texttt{rankin\_\allowbreak positivity\_\allowbreak miniature\_\allowbreak probe.py} and \texttt{hecke\_\allowbreak orbit\_\allowbreak transfer\_\allowbreak probe.py}; their valid Jacobi, Hecke and Rankin--Selberg identities remain, while T52 is narrowed to a path-space vacuum resolvent plus classical local Satake determinants, not a path-space Fredholm determinant.  The global all-place intersection form and its independent positivity remain OPEN.  NO RH CLAIM.  Surfaces: \texttt{note\_hilbert\_polya\_truncations}; \texttt{tfpt\_prime\_front}; catalog part 19; concept map; dated RH balance; website T49 erratum; ScriptIndex and website changelog regenerated.}

Consequence typed honestly: modules v554--v1019 had never run on GitHub CI before this fix -- and the first pass beyond v553 exposed the second blocker: \texttt{v570\_\allowbreak separation\_\allowbreak floor.py} section 4 materialised the $n\times n$ pair kernel by outer products ($n$ up to $26091$ atoms on the kernel subset: $5.4$\,GB per dense temporary, $>30$\,GB peak), which OOM-killed the 16\,GB runner (exit 143; reproduced in a 14\,GB Linux container).  The three pair-level readouts (Cauchy--Binet form, negative pair mass, best single pair) are now evaluated in row blocks (\texttt{pair\_kernel\_stats}); peak $32.7\to3.5$\,GB, 8/8 unchanged, only the Cauchy--Binet noise figure moves $4.5{\times}10^{-14}\to4.1{\times}10^{-14}$ (bar $10^{-9}$).  Third obstacle, structural: a hosted runner is $\sim$2.3$\times$ slower than the reference machine (v570 reached after 28\,min vs.\ 12\,min), so the full suite ($\sim$3\,h here) cannot finish inside GitHub's 6-hour job limit; \texttt{run\_all.py} gained \texttt{--shard K/N} (the $K$-th of $N$ interleaved slices, index mod $N$ -- the slices partition the list exactly and the interleaving spreads the heavy modules v640--v680 / v770--v790 evenly; measured $\le 38$\,min per slice of four on the reference machine) and \texttt{verify.yml} runs a $2\times4$ matrix (Python 3.11/3.12 $\times$ shard 1--4) with unbuffered stdout, so a crash is reported at the module that caused it (the buffered CI log had pointed at v568 while v570 was the culprit).  The local exit gate stays the plain \texttt{python run\_all.py}.  Fourth, in the first sharded pass: \texttt{v649\_\allowbreak discipline\_\allowbreak audit.py} D6.1 required the git-ignored local \texttt{.lake/build} directory among its ``build artefacts'' -- a reference-machine fact, absent from every fresh checkout; the check now requires the COMMITTED build descriptors (\texttt{lakefile.lean}, \texttt{lake-manifest.json}, \texttt{lean-toolchain}) and reports the local build directory informationally (18/18; the fresh \texttt{lake build} is the Lean Proofs workflow's job).  Fifth, exposed by the interleaving itself: \texttt{v93} and \texttt{v99} compute module-level mpmath constants (e.g.\ $(2/3)^6$) at IMPORT time with whatever global precision the previous module left behind (\texttt{tfpt\_constants} sets $40$ digits at import; \texttt{v65}, \texttt{v35} and others lower \texttt{mp.dps} to $20$--$30$ inside \texttt{run()} and leave it there), so their $10^{-30}$ checks passed in the historical full order by accident and failed in shard 1/3 (reproduced: \texttt{v65} then \texttt{v93} $\Rightarrow$ 1 FAIL).  \texttt{run\_all.py} now restores the canonical precision before every module, which makes the suite order-independent -- every module sees exactly the state it sees standalone (where all 1012 are green).  Sixth, two environment defects from the first sharded pass: the runner's own \texttt{--shard} argument leaked into the \texttt{sys.argv} that the in-process embedded probes parse (v955--v959 and the other round-31-convention modules: ``unrecognized arguments'', exit 2, pattern gates red) -- \texttt{run\_all.py} now scrubs its options from \texttt{sys.argv} after parsing; and \texttt{v777} imports \texttt{yaml} for its preregistration file, which \texttt{requirements.txt} did not list (\texttt{pyyaml} added).  What REMAINS red on Linux after all of this is typed, not patched: four modules whose frozen bars or pins sit at platform round-off level -- \texttt{v916} C1 pins the SHA of the float certificate vector (k, norm and $\lambda_{\min}$ reproduce to every printed digit, the byte hash does not), \texttt{v966}/\texttt{v967} embed sealed probes whose CONTROL-world deviation is $1.3{\times}10^{-5}$ against a $10^{-6}$ bar (the main identities sit at $10^{-16}$), and \texttt{v990} W(c-frozen) has its control at $1.1$--$2.2{\times}10^{-8}$ against a $10^{-8}$ tolerance.  Widening a sealed bar is a re-seal and is left to the owner; the reference platform for those pins is the Apple-Silicon/Accelerate stack.  \textbf{(2) Sync Audit workflow.} \texttt{build.sh audit} runs the rh/ gate (\texttt{run\_rh.py --fast}) after \texttt{audit\_sync.py}; the workflow installed no dependencies, so 257 sealed probes failed on \texttt{numpy}.  With the dependencies installed (incl.\ \texttt{numba}, on which the SHA-pinned probe r445 gates) the gate still failed on GitHub, and those failures are not repairable from the repository: the sealed probes are bound to the reference machine -- r464/r475/r487 read the git-ignored \texttt{rh/lean/.lake} mathlib cache, and on Linux (glibc $+$ OpenBLAS, arm64 and x86-64 alike) 19/257 sealed smoke gates miss their frozen control bars by round-off (e.g.\ r257 G21: controls $9.9{\times}10^{-3}$ vs bar $10^{-3}$), on \texttt{macos-latest} still 6/257.  Sealed sources are not edited to fit a platform; \texttt{audit.yml} therefore runs exactly what the badge names -- \texttt{audit\_sync.py}, platform-neutral, green -- and documents that the rh/ gate stays in the local \texttt{bash build.sh audit} on the reference machine (a reproducibility debt now typed, not hidden).  \textbf{(3) README currency.} Prediction count aligned with the website (27 status-graded falsifiable test surfaces, 16-entry frozen core registry) in the README prose, the hero image, the terminal GIF and the \texttt{./verify} footer (all said 23); the document count corrected to the 12 published documents $+$ the repo-only \texttt{tfpt\_prime\_front} (\texttt{docs/THEORY.md} list completed with S, N1, N2, P); the \texttt{--full} runtime corrected from ``$\sim$4 min'' to $\sim$4--5 h (README, \texttt{verify}, \texttt{docs/VERIFICATION.md}); the Zenodo DOI corrected to the v5.4 record \texttt{10.5281/zenodo.21128999} ($+$ concept DOI \texttt{18328333}; \texttt{20846087} is the v5.3 record); the \texttt{SEAM.EQUIV.01} status-table row reworded per the 2026-07-22 route split (the ``modulo a cited theorem'' clause belongs to \texttt{SEAM.EQUIV.MMST.01}~\mC).  \textbf{(4) Lean Proofs workflow.} Every run since the evening of 2026-08-03 ended in the runner's shutdown signal (exit 143): the default target fans out over the 4 cores of the 16\,GB runner, and since 2026-08-10 it also pulls in the 17 generated \texttt{WallLadder/RungKz*} kernel-\texttt{decide} certificates (21--360\,GB each; by the project's own README buildable only serially via \texttt{scripts/build\_wall\_ladder.sh}). % Original source: changelog.tex:2117-2187 at ba2f0fc; exact block follows.
\subsection*{\interlinepenalty=150\relax 2026-07-29 (XX) (prime-front diary T175 (the placement phases are real and causal but non-smooth, the heterogeneity dissolves into the error bar, and the densest reachable bin is consistent with zero --- PHASES-RESIST) + paper + website sync; NO promotion, NO marker moves)}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.5em]
\item \textbf{Prime-front diary T175 (\texttt{phase\_placement\_probe.py}, contract
\texttt{PHASE.PLACEMENT}, $38/38$, $20.2$\,s, $1504$ cells on $188$ anchors --- every
prime power in $[40,1090]$ is an anchor, no selection, no frame rule anywhere ---
crossed with the T174 ladder $h=160\ldots1280$ plus the declared floor $h=128$; verdict
PHASES-RESIST, sandbox).} \emph{(1) The phases.} The preregistered anchor invariant
$\theta_p=\mathrm{frac}(\log p/\alpha)$ is unusable and the probe says so out loud (a
smooth monotone function of $\alpha$, Rayleigh $Z=1296$ --- a regression on it would be
an $\alpha$-regression in disguise); only the cell phase
$\varphi_p(h)=\mathrm{frac}(h\theta_p)$ is free and equidistributed (largest $Z=1.41$
on $1316$ cells), with the generating identity
$\mathrm{frac}(\log p/D)=\mathrm{frac}(h\,\mathrm{frac}(\log p/\alpha))$ certified at
$1.1\times10^{-13}$ (Weyl 1916). \emph{The phases are real in $\log R$}: $F=10.80$
against a within-rung-scrambled null with $95\%$ point $1.69$, $+10.3\%$ held-out
residual variance under a rank-parity split, a composite placebo family at
$F=0.81/-0.0275$, amplitudes monotone in $p$ ($0.018$ at $p=5$ to $0.141$ at $p=19$).
\emph{But they are not the heterogeneity channel}: residual
$\chi^2/\mathrm{dof}=2.52$ from $3.14$ (target $<2$ missed), the held-out excess
scatter gets \emph{worse} ($-15.4\%$), the deficit untouched ($0.18\sigma$); the
exploratory scan excludes every other anchor statistic (all improve in sample and
worsen held out). \emph{What resolves the heterogeneity is the error bar}: with
jackknife slope errors the excess scatter goes $0.1224\to0.0000$ and the robust pull
spread $1.41\to1.22$ (model-free interleaved half-split $0.2722$ against
$\mathrm{sd}=0.2789$) --- T174's $\chi^2$ was substantially an OLS independence
assumption, not a physical spread; \emph{the $5\sigma$ deficit is unaffected} (its bar
never came from $\mathrm{se}_n$). \emph{(2) The dense limit.} The corner is exhausted
($\mathrm{dens}\le361$ forced by the sieve cap and $h\ge128$; $359$ reached); the
deficit(dens) curve over three decades ($6$ declared ratio-$4$ bins, cluster-robust)
falls $+0.982\pm0.213\to+0.576\to+0.207\to+0.194\to+0.088\to-0.057\pm0.132$ ---
monotone within $2\sigma$ at every step, density slope $6.1\sigma$, \emph{the densest
reachable bin consistent with zero}; the extrapolation fence is explicit: a true zero,
a power-law approach and a plateau below $0.132$ are all consistent --- undecidable
under this sieve. The sharpened confound test finds \emph{both} channels significant
($\log h$ $+0.2435\pm0.0670$, $\log\mathrm{dens}$ $-0.0631\pm0.0172$; curvature
$a_2=-0.137\pm0.029$) --- T174's density driver survives but is no longer unique; the
deficit is not a single exponent. Unplanned load-bearing finding: mass-preserving
alternative assemblies are \emph{inadmissible} (lump $0\%$, wide $46\%/0\%$ PD
survival); the admissible continuous deformation gives sensitivities $+0.384$ (sparse)
vs $-1.054$ (dense), ratio $0.4$ --- the sparse corner is \emph{not} an assembly
artefact. \emph{(3) Rule proposal $+$ intervention.} $\mathrm{dens}\ge1$ proposed for
the chain convention ($+0.722\pm0.094$ unresolved vs $+0.099\pm0.019$ resolved,
$6.5\sigma$ separation, $6\%$ of cells; explicitly not retroactive); comb scramble
destroys $12/12$; \emph{the new phase intervention} (with an exact $\delta=0$ rebuild
control): displacing the six family atoms inside their cells gives
$d\log R/d\delta=879$, linear to a factor $1.011$ over four declared decades ---
\emph{the placement phase is causal for $R$}, the first interventional statement of
the series --- and it overturns the \emph{shape} of the D1 result: the fitted first
harmonic predicts only $2.89$ (a factor ${\sim}300$ too small), positive definiteness
dies for $\delta\ge10^{-3}$, $\mathrm{GAP}=1.6\times10^{-9}$--$4.8\times10^{-6}$ ---
the Schur floor is a near-degeneracy and $\log R$ is necessarily \emph{non-smooth} in
the phases. Candidates P175-1--P175-8 PENDING, no promotion. The rest: the closed-form
$d\lambda_{\min}=v^{\mathsf T}\,d\hat A\,v$ response (R1); \emph{the dense-corner zero
needs a larger sieve, nothing else} (R2); the curvature vs the exponent reading (R3);
an $h$ floor for the positivity margin (R4); the last $22\%$ of the pull spread (R5).
T176 (\texttt{DENSE.LIMIT}, \texttt{dense\_limit\_probe.py}) is running --- the larger
sieve. Diary counters $175$ probes / $4716$ checks (series (CLXXXVI)).
\item \textbf{Paper + website sync.} \texttt{tfpt\_prime\_front}: new phase-2
subsection (T175: the cell-phase construction with the invariant trap said out loud,
the causality finding as key result, the error-bar resolution of the heterogeneity as
the honest correction, the density curve with the zero-consistent end bin and the
extrapolation fence, keybox ``After T175'' with the larger sieve as the only road and
T176 running), section title T126$\to$T175, abstract counters $175/4716$, probe index
extended (T175 row, running totals, T176 running);
\texttt{experiments/next.txt} T175 entry (counters $175$ Proben / $4716$ Checks, Serie
(CLXXXVI)); website: \texttt{primeFront.ts} feed entry T175 (verdict enum
PHASES-RESIST added), status surfaces Teile 11--175 / $4716$ checks
(\texttt{page.tsx}, \texttt{HonestyBanner.tsx}, \texttt{ModuleLadder.tsx}). NO
promotion; NO marker moves; not RH evidence.
\end{itemize}

% Original source: changelog.tex:2540-2635 at ba2f0fc; exact block follows.
\subsection*{\interlinepenalty=150\relax 2026-07-29 (XV) (prime-front diary T168+T169 (the self-similarity of the hardness is \emph{proved}, the one open object becomes a bilinear von Mangoldt sum --- MINORS-RESIST / RATIO-RESISTS) + paper + website sync; NO promotion, NO marker moves)}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.5em]
\item \textbf{Prime-front diary T168 (\texttt{lagrange\_minors\_probe.py}, contract
\texttt{LAGRANGE.MINORS}, $39/39$, $2.3$\,s, the same $63$-window union as
T163--T167, recipe untouched; verdict MINORS-RESIST, sandbox).} The determinant
attacked as a sum of squares via the Lagrange identity --- and the sum of
squares is \emph{real}: the $h\times h$ arithmetic kernel $A$ is
\textbf{positive definite on all $63$ windows}
($\lambda_{\min}=5.0\times10^{-6}$--$8.5\times10^{-4}$, $8$--$12$ orders above
the solver floor), so the Lagrange identity is a genuine sum of strictly
positive squares ($\rho_{\mathrm{LAG}}=1.000$ exactly, no sign cancellation)
--- hard-fenced as a statement about one finite matrix per window; the Weil
criterion is never tested, assumed or reverse-inferred. The anatomy is exact:
$Q=X^{\mathsf T}AX$ ($3.9\times10^{-15}$), the mode vectors are
\textbf{Euclidean-orthogonal} ($r_{12}=0$ to $6.2\times10^{-17}$ --- the
near-parallelism is created \emph{entirely} by the arithmetic metric), the
Wronskian telescopes exactly ($W_r-W_{r-1}=(\mu_1-\mu_2)u_rv_r$,
$1.7\times10^{-13}$), the minor sup is closed and $m$-free ($\sim N/\pi^2$,
attained to $0.770$), Cauchy--Binet verified as algebra. The key measurement
splits by basis: in the closed basis the minors are \emph{maximal}
($\tfrac12\sum M^2=1/(\mu_1\mu_2)$ exactly $\sim h^4$ --- the Wronskians carry
zero arithmetic, all smallness sits in the PSD kernel at one closed vector);
in the eigenbasis the sum is \emph{thin} ($90\%$ from $4$--$101$ pairs, top
pair always $(\lambda_{\min},\lambda_{\max})$ at $6.8$--$41.7\%$ alone, raw
$\kappa_w=0.30$--$0.94$). The exponent ledger closes arithmetic-free:
$1-r_{12}^2=\nu_1\nu_2/(\hat a_{11}\hat a_{22})$ with $\nu_1\sim h^{+0.81}$,
$\hat a_{11}\sim h^{+0.76}$, $\hat a_{22}\sim h^{+0.91}$ --- every factor but
one at the right power; best $m$-free-shaped bound $h^{-0.548}$ union /
$h^{-0.880}$ frame A, short by $h^{2.45}/h^{2.04}$; the open factor is
identified exactly: $\nu_2$ with minimiser $t^*=Q_{12}/Q_{11}$, needed to
$6.05\times10^{-3}$ median / $2.82\times10^{-4}$ worst ($h^{-1.146}$) --- by
T168-TH7 that factor \emph{is} the target rewritten (ONE-TERM-MISSING
deliberately not rendered). Scramble breaks harder than T167 ($8/8$ windows
lose $A\succ0$ \emph{and} the Gram property, $n_{\mathrm{neg}}$ up to $73$);
$L_P$ control exact. \textbf{The hardness is self-similar under exact
reformulation} --- determinant $\to$ PSD compound at a closed vector $\to$
near-null Rayleigh value $\to$ one ratio of two closed lag sums, same
accuracy price. Balance $8$ THEOREM / $0$ CERT-UNIF / $3$ CERT-WINDOW /
$11$ MEASURED / $7$ NO-GO.
\item \textbf{Prime-front diary T169 (\texttt{tstar\_ratio\_probe.py}, contract
\texttt{TSTAR.RATIO}, $41/41$, $3.0$\,s, same union surface; verdict
RATIO-RESISTS --- the self-similarity \emph{proved}, sandbox).} T168's one
open factor attacked as a preregistered candidate table: every genuinely
closed candidate misses by $O(1)$ and \emph{diverges} from the threshold at
$h^{+1.99}$ (the block is atom-dominated, $|{\rm atom/arch}|=3.5$--$43$ resp.\
$14$--$461$, and $\hat a_{11}^{\mathrm{arch}}<0$ on $63/63$ --- the
archimedean half is not even PSD); \textbf{the only candidate that meets the
threshold, $K7=\sqrt{\hat a_{22}/\hat a_{11}}$ ($63/63$), does so by a new
theorem (T169-TH7) because it puts $\det\hat A$ back into the numerator}:
$R(K7)$ collapses in closed form to $2\sqrt{\hat a_{11}\hat a_{22}}\,\det\hat
A/[(\hat a_{11}+\hat a_{22})(\sqrt{\hat a_{11}\hat a_{22}}+\hat a_{12})]$
($1.1\times10^{-9}$) --- \textbf{the $t^*$-language is provably exactly as
hard as T167's determinant: the loop closes as an identity} (T167 scalar
$\to$ T168 factor $\to$ T169 candidate = the same object). The real gains:
\textbf{R3 is booked CERT-UNIF --- $\nu_1\le\max(\hat a_{11},\hat
a_{22})+|\hat a_{12}|$ (Gershgorin, unconditional, uniform in $h$), $63/63$,
losing only $1.10$--$1.19$ --- the CERT-UNIF column moves off zero}; R2 is
honestly downgraded from cheap to OPEN (the absolute-value budget cannot even
certify positivity); the chain is \textbf{rebuilt R4-free} ($1-r_{12}^2\le
[\max(\hat a_{11},\hat a_{22})+|\hat a_{12}|]\cdot R(\hat t)/(\hat
a_{11}\hat a_{22})$, valid $63/63$, frame-A trend $h^{-2.948}$, i.e.\
$\varepsilon=0.052$ inside the $0.5$ carry window) so the Weil-shaped
positivity of $A_h$ never enters it --- the Weil fence is respected by
construction (uniform-in-$h$ positivity of $A_h$ is RH-equivalent-shaped and
is never routed or claimed); and by T169-TH3 the $1/\sqrt{\mu}$ factors
cancel, so the $\mathrm{cond}\sim10^{8}$ ladder leaves the file. Stress:
$L_P$ exact (the $t^*$-recipe is a near-degeneracy artefact --- its tightness
\emph{measures} $\det\hat A$), scramble $8/8$, flat-weight null $8/8$,
parity-pair control only $6.7\times$ (honestly PARTIAL). Balance
\textbf{$10$ THEOREM / $2$ CERT-UNIF / $1$ CERT-WINDOW / $4$ NO-GO}. The rest:
\textbf{R1, for the first time in standard analytic shape --- an $m$-free
bound on $\det\hat A$ at $h^{-3+\varepsilon}$ as a bilinear von Mangoldt sum
against closed Dirichlet weights} (equivalently the diagonal ratio to
$1.2\times10^{-2}/5.6\times10^{-4}$); R2 $=$ R1; R3 closed; R4 not needed.
T170 (\texttt{bilinear\_sieve\_probe.py}, contract \texttt{BILINEAR.SIEVE})
is running the unconditional sieve toolbox (Montgomery--Vaughan, Vaughan
decomposition) on the bilinear form --- T161's beyond-RH triage applied to
\emph{linear} sums; for \emph{bilinear} forms the large sieve gives
unconditional square-root cancellation.
\item \textbf{Docs + website sync.} \texttt{tfpt\_prime\_front} gains the T168
subsection (the Lagrange identity and the PSD finding with the hard Weil
fence, the basis split of the key measurement, the closed exponent ledger,
the self-similarity statement) and the T169 subsection (the candidate table,
the collapse theorem TH7 with the loop closure as the key result, the
CERT-UNIF gain, the R4-free chain with $\varepsilon=0.052$, the
standard-shape restatement, the ``After T169'' keybox with R1 in bilinear
shape and T170 running); the phase-2 section title moves to T126--T169, the
probe index gains the T168+T169 rows and the running totals move to $169$
probes / $4474$ checks; \texttt{experiments/next.txt} gains both entries
(series (CLXXIX), (CLXXX)); website: \texttt{primeFront.ts} feed entries
T168+T169, status surfaces Teile 11--169 / $4474$ checks, T170 running. NO
promotion (T168/T169 candidates PENDING --- bundling with T170 planned).
Firewall unchanged: sandbox, no RH evidence, no zero data; every number typed
THEOREM/CERT-UNIF/CERT-WINDOW/MEASURED/FIT.
\end{itemize}

\subsection*{\interlinepenalty=150\relax 2026-07-29 (XIV) (\texttt{v557} --- the cascade/vector identities of phase 2 promoted; prime-front diary T167 (three dresses are one inequality, the closed vector exact at $K=2$ --- VECTOR-RESISTS) + paper + website sync; NO marker moves)}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.5em]
\item \textbf{New module \texttt{v557} (\texttt{PRIME.CASCADE.VECT.01}).} Promotion of
the closed theorem cores of T166 (contract \texttt{SCHUR.CASCADE}) and T167 (contract
\texttt{NULL.VECTOR}) as one deliberately narrow module
(\texttt{v557\_cascade\_vector\_identities.py}, $23$ checks, ${\sim}0.1$\,s), everything
recomputed on \texttt{v551}--\texttt{v556}'s declared small frame-A surface ($12$ deepest
in-cap zones, $m=96\ldots291\le300$; $\kappa=0.038821$ verified at every jump point of
$\psi(x)/x$ on the table): \emph{(1)} the cascade identities --- prefix (one Cholesky,
all sixteen rungs, $1.1\times10^{-12}$ on $192$ comparisons), minor form
$1/g_K=\det G_{[1..K]}/(\mu^P_1\det G_{[2..K]})$ on the raw arithmetic Gram block
($2.7\times10^{-12}$; Schur 1917) and regression form $g_K/g_1=1/(1-R_K^2)$
($8.8\times10^{-13}$); \emph{(2)} the diagonal invariance of the gain under $B\to DBD$
($2.7\times10^{-12}$ on $144$ random diagonals --- the gain belongs to the arithmetic
Gram block alone); \emph{(3)} the exact $K=2$ identity --- the closed vector
$(1,-Q_{21}/Q_{22})$ attains $1/g_2=Q_{11}(1-r_{12}^2)$ exactly and
$B_{11}g_2=1/(1-r_{12}^2)$ identically ($1.2\times10^{-12}$): the fast-null-vector is
FREE at $K=2$, dress (c) collapses onto dress (b); \emph{(4)} the pivot identity
$u^{\mathsf T}Q_Ku=1/g_K+\delta^{\mathsf T}Q_K\delta$ for $\delta_1=0$
($2.0\times10^{-12}$ on $252$ evaluations; the $\delta_1=0.1$ mutation breaks by exactly
the closed cross term $2\delta_1$) with the exact entry threshold and the unification
$(1/g_2)/S_2=(1-r_{12}^2)/(1+3r_{12}^2)$ --- ONE inequality, not three; \emph{(5)} the
trial theorem ($288$ trials, every candidate a certified lower bound), the $L_P$ no-go
(cascade gain exactly $1$, deviation $0.0$) and the scramble type-change ($B_{11}$
itself loses positivity on $49/60$ declared draws, a majority on $12/12$ windows) as
must-breaks; every statement with a mutation control; the one open scalar R1 (an
$m$-free upper bound on $1-r_{12}^2$) explicitly typed OPEN; NO RH statement. Ledger row
\texttt{PRIME.CASCADE.VECT.01}; registered in \texttt{run\_all.py} and
\texttt{script\_registry.csv}; suite counter $550\to551$ scripts.
\item \textbf{Prime-front diary T167 (\texttt{null\_vector\_probe.py}, contract
\texttt{NULL.VECTOR}, $39/39$, $1.4$\,s, the $63$-window union of T166 rebuilt bit for
bit; T163--T166 reproduced as fits; verdict VECTOR-RESISTS with a strong reduction,
sandbox).} The most constructive dress attacked and closed \emph{as a construction}:
$22$ families preregistered, all evaluated through the pivot identity
$u^{\mathsf T}Qu=1/g_K+\delta^{\mathsf T}Q\delta$ ($10206$ evaluations,
$3.2\times10^{-9}$) --- \textbf{gram2 is EXACT at $K=2$} ($\rho=0$, a theorem: the
closed vector attains $1/g_2$ on $63/63$, $B_{11}g_2=1/(1-r_{12}^2)$ an identity,
certified gain exponent $h^{+2.921}$ on frame A $=h^{3-0.079}$, $h^{+2.246}$ union).
Perturbation theory dies structurally: Jacobi diverges (radius $1.0$--$12.7$) but
\textbf{the Kato series CONVERGES (radius $0.067$) --- to the WRONG object} (the exact
bottom eigenvector is itself a useless trial, $\rho=6.04$, overlap $0.083$, relative
gap $5.4\times10^{-7}$) --- closed off in every order. Two thresholds separated
(envelopes on $189$ perturbations each); \textbf{monotonically sharper in $K$ ---
mildest at $K=2$ ($1.90\times$, $h^{+0.353}$), against the hypothesis and exactly where
the vector is free}; at $K=6$ no closed family hits (separation $h^{+1.138}$, ratio
$264\times$); anchor $\mathrm{eps}_{\mathrm{ent}}(2)\to(1-r_{12}^2)/4$ --- T166's
$3.57\times10^{-4}$ is literally the quarter. End-to-end gain $2207$--$7.84\times10^{6}$
certified; the deficit is the higher rungs, not the vector; \textbf{the scramble breaks
harder than T166 saw: $8/8$ windows lose positivity of the $2\times2$ diagonal itself
($Q_{11}=-1.35\times10^{5}\ldots-1.02\times10^{4}$) --- a change of TYPE, not a
factor}; anti-fitting cheat only $h^{-0.823}$; off-recipe $1-r_{12}^2\sim h^{-2.740}$
vs $h^{-2.921}$. \textbf{The unification as an identity:}

% Original source: changelog.tex:2713-2790 at ba2f0fc; exact block follows.
\subsection*{\interlinepenalty=150\relax 2026-07-29 (XIII) (prime-front diary T166 (the cascade gain is a Gram-determinant cancellation, one inequality in three dresses --- CASCADE-RESISTS) + paper + website sync; NO promotion, NO marker moves)}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.5em]
\item \textbf{Prime-front diary T166 (\texttt{schur\_cascade\_probe.py}, contract
\texttt{SCHUR.CASCADE}, $30/30$, $2.1$\,s, the two surfaces rebuilt as a
\emph{union}: $27$ frame-A windows $h=142$--$1320$ plus $36$ decoupled-$\nu$
windows over $6$ zones, $\nu\in\{4,5,6,8,11,16\}$, $h=96$--$1371$ --- $63$
windows with a $14\times$ lever arm on which zone depth and resolution are
independent knobs ($\log h$ vs $\log\nu$ correlated $0.33$); T165's three
numbers reproduced on frame A, the union reading
$h^{+2.759}/h^{+0.193}/h^{+2.566}$; $\kappa=0.038821$ verified at every jump
point in $[100,4\times10^{5}]$; verdict CASCADE-RESISTS, sandbox).} The one
open object of T165 --- the cascade lower bound $g_{16}/g_1\ge c\,h^{3-\varepsilon}$
uniform in $m$ --- attacked head-on and dissected completely. \emph{The
anatomy:} four identities, all theorems re-verified on $63/63$ windows ---
the prefix property (one Cholesky yields all sixteen rungs), the minor form
(Schur 1917), the \textbf{regression form $g_K/g_1=1/(1-R_K^2)$} (the open
object \emph{is} a near-collinearity: mode $1$ explained by modes $2\ldots16$
up to a residual $h^{-3+\varepsilon}$), and the \textbf{diagonal invariance}
of the gain under $B\to DBD$ --- it does not see the KMS $1/\sqrt{\mu}$
normalisation at all: the $h^3$ is a property of the arithmetic Gram block
$G=TAT^{\mathsf T}$ alone. The rung profile is extreme: rung $2$ alone
carries a median $59\%$ of the gain, rungs $2$--$5$ $72\%$,
$K_{\mathrm{half}}\in\{2..5\}$ on $63/63$; rung $2$ in closed form has
$1-r_{12}^2=1.3\times10^{-7}$--$4.5\times10^{-4}\sim h^{-2.92}$ (frame A) ---
one rung multiplies $g$ by $2207$--$7.8\times10^{6}$ where the $m$-free
budgets are sharp only to a factor $21$--$26$.
\item \textbf{The cancellation finding --- a third mechanism.} No entry of
the $2\times2$ bottom block cancels (each keeps $60$--$99\%$ of its larger
half) and neither half alone is collinear (arch $1-r^2=0.98$, atoms $0.29$)
--- yet the sum is degenerate to seven digits: \textbf{the cancellation lives
in the $2\times2$ Gram determinant} --- the polarisation split
$\det(G_{\mathrm{ar}}+G_{\mathrm{at}})=\det G_{\mathrm{ar}}+\det
G_{\mathrm{at}}+\Pi$ (exact to $6.7\times10^{-14}$) has pieces $2.6$--$630$
cancelling to $1.0\times10^{-3}$--$1.7\times10^{-2}$, a ratio
$2.6\times10^{-6}$--$5.1\times10^{-4}\sim h^{-1.45}$ --- the same
arch-against-atom mechanism as T159/T160, one level up, in a quadratic
functional of the lag sums. Pinned to the arithmetic twice: the $L_P$ no-go
breaks completely (gain $\equiv1.0000000000$ exactly), and the anti-fitting
scramble (uniform random atom positions, same total mass) destroys the
effect by a factor $4569$.
\item \textbf{The best lower bound, the verdict, and two honest contract
corrections.} Every route is an instance of the trial-vector theorem
($1/g_K=\mu_1^{P\,-1}\min\{u^{\mathsf T}Gu:u_1=1\}$); the best closed route
(two-rung, $\beta$ from the atom block) certifies gain $h^{+1.319}$ against
the target $h^{+3.110}$ --- \textbf{an exponent gap of $h^{+1.791}$, not a
constant: the one missing inequality \emph{is} the cancellation} (required
$\beta$ precision $3.57\times10^{-4}$, all closed candidates miss by
$12.4$--$2540$); sharpest restatement
$1/g_K=\det G_{[1..K]}/(\mu^P_1\det G_{[2..K]})$, first flat at $K=6$ ---
exactly one uniform inequality missing, in three dresses (the det-ratio
bound, the closed $\beta$, a closed near-null vector of $A$ in the low
modes). Corrections recorded honestly: form F2 (gain
$\ge c\,h^{3-\varepsilon}$) is strictly \emph{weaker} than
$\inf_m g_{16}>0$ ($B_{11}\sim h^{+3.110}$, F1 needs
$\varepsilon\le-0.110$); the confinement route was a sub-surface artefact
($h^{+2.714}$ on frame A $h\le780$ vs $h^{+1.963}$ on the full union ---
exposed by raising the eigen-horizon to the cap). Errand closed:
$U_{\mathrm{ref}}(\text{union})=1.15\times6.4781=7.45$ supersedes T164's
$4.90$ and T165's $5.7327$ on the union (off-recipe rule declared,
CERT-WINDOW, never CERT-UNIF); the union supremum is zone-depth-driven
(multi-covariate gain $\sim h^{+2.92}\nu^{-1.53}$). Balance $+5$ THEOREM /
$+3$ CERT-WINDOW / $+4$ MEASURED, deliberately no new CERT-UNIF; candidates
P166.1\ldots P166.9 all PENDING (no promotion --- bundling with T167
planned). T167 (\texttt{null\_vector\_probe.py}, contract
\texttt{NULL.VECTOR}) is running the most constructive dress.
\item \textbf{Docs + website sync.} \texttt{tfpt\_prime\_front} gains the T166
subsection (regression form, diagonal invariance and the Gram-minor ratio as
displays, the Gram-determinant key result with the T159/T160 connection, the
scramble factor, the two contract corrections, the ``After T166'' keybox),
the phase-2 section title moves to T126--T166, the probe index gains the
T166 row and the running totals move to $166$ probes / $4355$ checks;
\texttt{experiments/next.txt} gains the T166 entry (series (CLXXVII));
website: \texttt{primeFront.ts} feed entry T166, status surfaces
Teile 11--166 / 4355 checks, T167 running. Firewall unchanged: sandbox, no
RH evidence, no zero data; every number typed
THEOREM/CERT-UNIF/CERT-WINDOW/MEASURED/FIT.
\end{itemize}

\subsection*{\interlinepenalty=150\relax 2026-07-29 (XII) (\texttt{v556} --- the gauge/$P_{\mathrm{pr}}$ identities of phase 2 promoted; prime-front diary T165 (the successor closes by certificate, one quantifier remains --- ETA-RESISTS) + paper + website sync; NO marker moves)}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.5em]
\item \textbf{New module \texttt{v556} (\texttt{PRIME.GAUGE.PPR.01}).} Promotion of
the closed theorem cores of the discovery parts T164 (\texttt{sector\_change\_probe.py})
and T165 (\texttt{alignment\_eta\_probe.py}) --- $23$ checks, ${\sim}0.3$\,s, everything
recomputed on \texttt{v551}--\texttt{v555}'s declared surface (the $12$ deepest
prime-power zones admitting a frame-A window inside the cap, $n=29\ldots139$,
$m=96\ldots291\le300$), with the one arithmetic input $\kappa=0.038821$
\emph{verified} at every jump point of $\psi(x)/x$ on the von-Mangoldt table in
$[100,3.2\times10^{5}]$ (Chebyshev 1852 / Rosser--Schoenfeld 1962), nothing cited from
the sandbox; the companion to \texttt{v555}, which certified the \emph{price
structure} of the pairing --- this module certifies its \emph{gauge structure}. Scope
fence: per-instance identities and certified inequalities with the direction in the
name --- no fit, no $D$-exponent, no zone-uniform statement; the T164/T165
$h$-exponents ($1/g_{16}\sim h^{+0.061}$, the ascent price $\sim h^{+3.3}$, the split
$+3.110-3.049=+0.061$) are sandbox fits and are \emph{not} consumed; finite
$\Lambda$-sums are allowed and used, \emph{no RH statement} is made; the ONE open
object after T165 ($\inf_m g_{16}(m)>0$, the cascade-gain quantifier) stays open and
typed open; each statement carries at least one mutation control that must fail
loudly.
\item \textbf{(1) The gauge theorem (T164, S2.1) \mE.} $x_1=1$ fixes
$a_1=1/\sqrt{\mu_1}$, i.e.\ only the \emph{scale} of $a$; $Q$ and TV are homogeneous
of degree two in $a$; hence the demand ratio $Q/\mathrm{TV}$ of the same
$a$-direction --- and with it $\delta_{\mathrm{bnd}}$ --- is the \emph{same number in
every sector}: unchanged to $2.9\times10^{-11}$ on $2520$ sector-by-trial-vector
combinations ($5$ weight families $\times$ $7$ shifts $\times$ $6$ taper widths on
$12$ windows), with $\mathrm{TV}\ge|w_0|$ in every sector and the pure shift scaling
the certified value by exactly $\theta=\mu^P_1/(\mu^P_1+\kappa_s)$
($2.2\times10^{-11}$ on $432$ points); candidate (i) settled in closed form ---
full-space $\mu_0=0$ exactly, strictly worse. Mutation: the wrong transport map
(the $x$-coordinates instead of the $a$-direction) moves the ratio by
$2.0\times10^{2}$--$5.4\times10^{3}$.
\item \textbf{(2) The $h^2$ conservation law (T164, S2.2) \mE.} floor $\times$
transfer $=1/(\mu^P_1+\kappa_s)\cdot(1+\kappa_s/\mu^P_1)=1/\mu^P_1$
\emph{identically} at every shift on the declared grid ($72$ window-by-shift points,
$2.2\times10^{-16}$): a sector shift can flatten the floor but pays the identical
factor back as a transfer --- the $h^2$ is conserved, never removed; it lives in the
\emph{ratio}, not in the floor. Mutation: the wrong transfer misses by $0.9995$ at
the largest shift on every window.
\item \textbf{(3) The power-one spend as an identity (T164, S1) \mE.} The $r$-ceiling
$r\le U/L$ with $L=\lambda_1(A)/\mu^P_1=1.1019$--$1.5845$ (computed per instance from
the full window) is \emph{linear} in the entry ceiling, so $d\log r/d\log U=+1$
exactly (central difference at $U=1/g_{16}$, within $1.1\times10^{-14}$ on $12/12$):
an $h^{\varepsilon}$ ceiling costs $h^{-\varepsilon}$ of $r$-margin for every
$\varepsilon>0$ --- no free tolerance in the consumption step (the measured power of
the full T156 loss margin stays sandbox). Mutation: the quadratic consumption reads
slope $2.0000$ and is recognised.
\item \textbf{(4) The $P_{\mathrm{pr}}$ identity and the predicate equivalence
(T165, T1) \mE.} The gauge-invariant dashboard satisfies
$P_{\mathrm{pr}}=g_{16}\cdot R\cdot(\mathrm{TV}/(t_1v)^2)/\mu^P_1$ with no inequality
anywhere --- four factors, each a named object of the chain: the R-E-A quantifier
$g_{16}$, the demand $R=Q/\mathrm{TV}$, the T163 floor $\mathrm{tvf}\ge1$, and the
Kac--Murdock--Szeg\H{o} 1953 scale $1/\mu^P_1=943.6$--$8609.6\sim h^2$ --- exact to
$4.3\times10^{-16}$ on all $192$ battery vectors (knob settings, random
sixteen-vectors \emph{and} random full-window vectors), gauge-invariant under
$v\to tv$ to $1.5\times10^{-11}$; the predicates $R>2\kappa$ and
$P_{\mathrm{pr}}>2\kappa g_{16}\,\mathrm{tvf}/\mu^P_1$ agree as booleans on all
$192$ --- the demand half of R2$''$ and the crossing condition are \emph{one}
predicate, so R-F was never independent and its $m$-uniform form \emph{is} R-E-A ---
and every crossing vector pays $P_{\mathrm{pr}}>2\kappa g_{16}/\mu^P_1=15.4$--$142.8$,
above the preregistered tolerance $\Theta_{\mathrm{TOL}}=10$ on $12/12$: \textbf{the
R-F conjunction is empty by an identity plus a floor, a certificate and not a failed
search} (T165's ascent stays sandbox, no search is run). Mutation: $(t_1v)$
unsquared scales like $t$ and moves by $1.0$--$1.0\times10^{4}$.
\item \textbf{(5) The Schur-cascade direction and the exponent closure (T164/T165)
\mE.} $s=\mu^P_1t_1^{\mathsf T}A^{-1}t_1=0.1696$--$0.2472\ge g_{16}\ge g_1$ window by
window ($1/s\le1/g_{16}\le1/g_1=B_{11}$ --- the T158 ladder is a chain of upper
bounds with the route-(0) rung the loosest), $P_K=\hat a\,s=254.8$--$7.7\times10^{3}
\ge1$ (Kantorovich 1948); the exponent closure is an \emph{identity of the lists}
--- per instance $\log(1/g_1)=\log(g_{16}/g_1)+\log(1/g_{16})$ to
$1.6\times10^{-15}$, the least-squares fits closing to $1.3\times10^{-15}$ by
linearity (T165's $+3.110-3.049=+0.061$ is this identity; the exponent values are
sandbox fits, not consumed --- what is promoted is that the certification lives in
the cascade gain $g_{16}/g_1$, the object of the one open quantifier). Mutations:
the $g_8$ closure breaks by $0.10$--$0.24$; a corrupted sixteen-block makes the
Cholesky \emph{refuse} on $12/12$. Plus the monotone no-go staircase (damage
$1.00\to3.49\to10.81\to24.98$ over $\nu=4/2/1/0.5$, exact null control) and exact
Dirichlet/parity controls.
\item \textbf{Prime-front diary T165 (\texttt{alignment\_eta\_probe.py}, contract
\texttt{ALIGNMENT.ETA}, $30/30$, $15.1$\,s, the T163/T164 surface rebuilt and
re-verified, window ladder up to $h=1445$, verdict ETA-RESISTS in the strong form,
sandbox).} The successor question R-F closes \emph{by certificate, not by failed
search}: the new gauge-invariant identity
$P_{\mathrm{pr}}=g_{16}\cdot R\cdot(\mathrm{TV}/(t_1v)^2)/\mu^P_1$ (machine-checked
to $3.3\times10^{-16}$) makes demand and price \emph{one} equation, so with T163's
floor every crossing vector pays $\ge2\kappa g_{16}/\mu^P_1$ --- the old KMS $h^2$
--- and the two R-F clauses cannot be chosen independently. The anatomy: the free
optimum is a \emph{low-harmonic} object ($93.7$--$96.8\%$ of its energy in the first
$32$ parity modes against a $2.4$--$22.5\%$ baseline), essentially orthogonal to the
PNT main term (cosine $-0.070\ldots-0.031$), with heavy edges on prime-power cells
(lift $1.36$--$2.12$); the price decomposes \emph{exactly} (to $0.0$):
$h^{+3.261}=+1.997$ (KMS --- the same $h^2$ since T152) $+1.279$ (demand overshoot
the chain never asked for) $+0.093$ (floor) $-0.108$ ($g_{16}$); the bar-tight
counterfactual stays $h^{+1.982}$. $\eta(\mathrm{Cap})$ is two-sided: the ceiling is
a theorem, and at $\mathrm{Cap}=10$ it falls short of the requirement by
$5.5$--$392\times$ on every window, $0/27$ ladder points reach the bar. The
equivalence: $R>2\kappa$ and T163's crossing predicate are the \emph{same} predicate
($105/105$ vectors) $\Rightarrow$ R-F is strictly \emph{stronger} than the R2$''$
demand, and the clauses collide --- \textbf{R-F is empty; its $m$-uniform form is
R-E-A}. T2 localises the quantifier further: the $m$-free budgets bound $B_{11}$
sharply (factor $21$--$26$) --- but the wrong object: $1/g_1$ grows $h^{+3.110}$,
$1/g_{16}$ is flat $h^{+0.061}$, exponents close exactly; the whole certification
lives in the $15$ ladder increments --- ``bound $g_{16}/g_1$ from below by
$h^{3-\varepsilon}$'', one scalar per window, a cancellation and hence provably
beyond absolute-value budgets. T3, the decoupled surface ($\nu$ as a knob: $25$
admissible windows over $6$ zones, $\nu\in\{4,5,6,8,11,16\}$, collinearity
$0.87\to0.68$): \textbf{the quarter-bar drift is zone depth, not window length
(factor $19$)} --- and two honest costs reported openly: $\sup1/g_{16}$ rises to
$5.7327$, exceeding T164's $U_{\mathrm{ref}}=4.90$ by $17\%$ (the constant was
frame-A-specific and is retired as a surface constant), and the $h$-coefficient of
$1/g_{16}$ is no longer negligible at free $\nu$. End-to-end on the union ($52$
windows, $h=142$--$1320$): every crossing vector has $P_{\mathrm{pr}}\ge54.6$--$5865
>\Theta_{\mathrm{TOL}}$, closed for every $h>84.9$. Stress: T145 coarsening
monotone ($1.0/2.8/12.1/27.5$, up to $102\times$); surrogate
$8.6\times10^{3}$--$6.9\times10^{4}$; Dirichlet/KMS exact. Balance $11$ THEOREM /
$1$ CERT-UNIF / $4$ CERT-WINDOW / $6$ MEASURED; $6$ new PENDING candidates.
\textbf{The honest bottom line: exactly ONE genuine open object remains ---
$\inf_m g_{16}(m)>0$, a quantifier over a certified flat list; no missing term, no
missing device, no sector.} T166 (\texttt{schur\_cascade\_probe.py}, contract
\texttt{SCHUR.CASCADE}) is running at exactly that quantifier. NOT RH evidence; no
marker of any pre-existing contract moves.
\item \textbf{Docs + website sync.} \texttt{tfpt\_prime\_front} gains the T165
subsection (the $P_{\mathrm{pr}}$ identity as the key display, the exact price
decomposition, the R-F $\iff$ R-E-A equivalence, the decoupled surface with the
zone-depth answer and the retired $U_{\mathrm{ref}}$ reported honestly) and the

% Original source: changelog.tex:2929-3019 at ba2f0fc; exact block follows.
\subsection*{\interlinepenalty=150\relax 2026-07-29 (XI) (prime-front diary T164 (both arms of the successor decided: the $O(1)$ gate discharges to a single quantifier, sectors are a gauge --- TOLERANCE-CARRIES (arm A) / SECTOR-RESISTS (arm B)) + paper + website sync; NO promotion, NO marker moves)}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.5em]
\item \textbf{Prime-front diary T164 (\texttt{sector\_change\_probe.py}, contract
\texttt{SECTOR.CHANGE}, $28/28$, $31.7$\,s, the T163 surface rebuilt and
re-verified: $28$ log-spaced prime-power zones $h=142\ldots1445$ with declared
caps, $27$ windows inside the cond horizon, $|\psi(x)-x|\le\kappa x$ with
$\kappa=0.038821$ verified at every jump point in $[100,4\times10^{5}]$; verdict
TOLERANCE-CARRIES (arm A) / SECTOR-RESISTS (arm B), sandbox).} Both arms of
T163's successor R-E are decided. \emph{Arm A (the tolerance analysis):} the
station chain is instrumented with a power at every station --- the T158 ladder
really is a chain of upper bounds on the entry ceiling ($s\ge g_{16}\ge g_1$
window by window), and at the heart the T156 kernel spends the ceiling at power
\emph{exactly one}: $d\log(1-F)/d\log U=-1.0005\ldots-1.0000$ with
$d\log r/d\log U=+1.0000$ exactly, so a ceiling growing like $h^{\varepsilon}$
costs a margin decaying like $h^{-\varepsilon}$ for every $\varepsilon>0$ ---
the declared one-sided rule returns $\varepsilon^*=0.50$ and the probe
\emph{disowns} it at once as the $\varepsilon=0$ tailwind ($h^{+0.391}$, bought
from the measured drift of $L$) divided by power one: no structural slack. But
the sharp question is answered the other way: the single constant
$U_{\mathrm{ref}}=4.9008=\max_h 1/g_{16}$ carries all $9$ sub-surface windows
out of sample, $1/g_{16}=1.7527$--$5.3286$ is flat ($h^{+0.061}$ over a
$9\times$ lever arm, split halves $-0.010/+0.103$), and every $g_K$ is strictly
increasing (Schur 1917) --- \textbf{the $O(1)$ gate is not open as a
\emph{quantity}: it is discharged window by window by a Cholesky identity},
and what remains is exactly one quantifier, $\sup_m 1/g_{16}(m)<\infty$ --- the
$m$-freedom of a certified flat list, the same grammatical form as every other
open uniformity item and no longer an existence question about trial vectors.
\emph{Arm B (the sector change), negative by a theorem:} $x_1=1$ fixes only the
\emph{scale} of $a$; $Q$ and TV are homogeneous of degree two, hence
$Q/\mathrm{TV}$ and $\delta_{\mathrm{bnd}}$ are the \emph{same numbers in every
sector} --- the entry normalisation is a \textbf{gauge} (machine-checked to
$8.8\times10^{-10}$ over $5670$ sector-by-vector combinations, declared horizon
$2.6\times10^{-8}$); the full space is strictly worse ($\mu_0=0$ exactly, no
finite floor); a shifted or weighted sector does flatten the floor
($h^{+0.000}$ at $\kappa_s=4$) but pays the transfer factor
$1/\theta\sim h^{+1.997}$, and floor${}\times{}$transfer $=1/\mu^P_1$
\emph{identically} --- the two exponents sum to $+1.997$ at every shift on the
declared grid to $10^{-9}$: the $h^2$ lives in the ratio, never in the floor.
The genuine surprise, stated and immediately priced: a normalisation-free
first-order ascent on $Q/\mathrm{TV}$ over the full window reaches
$2.38$--$74.57$ against the crossing bar $2\kappa=0.0776$ --- $31$--$960\times$
over on $9/9$ windows ($\delta_{\mathrm{bnd}}=-0.124\ldots-0.090$, alignment
efficiency $\eta=7.9$--$11.1\%$ of the Abel ceiling
$\|C\|_\infty=30.3$--$930.6\sim h^{+1.185}$) --- and T163's TV floor
\emph{holds on the unconstrained optimiser} ($\mathrm{TV}\,\mu^P_1=8.30$--$11.72
\ge1$, a family T163 never searched), at a price $h^{+3.299}$, worse than
T163's crossing price $h^{+1.91}$: dropping the normalisation relocated the
difficulty without reducing it.
\item \textbf{R-B$'''$ narrowed, R-D settled in type, R-F named.} R-B$'''$ is a
\emph{naming} problem --- two different quantities carried one name: the T162
$a$-weighted quarter-bar object is $0.1001$--$0.1623\sim h^{-0.172}$ (T163's
$-0.172$ reproduced to $0.0004$, under the $0.25$ bar on all $27$ windows with
$35\%$ margin), the raw arch/atom cancellation is a different number
($h^{-2.04}$); a two-variable regression puts $-0.046$ of the drift on
$\log h$ against $-0.477$ on $\log\alpha$ ($10\times$ more on the zone scale),
and on this recipe $\alpha$ and $h$ are coupled by construction --- narrowed,
not closed: a surface with independent $\alpha$ and $h$ is needed. R-D is
settled in \emph{type}: under the shift $s\to s/\theta$,
$\hat a\to\theta\hat a$, $L\to\theta L$, so $P_K$, $r$ and $F(P_K,r)$ are
unchanged to $3.5\times10^{-16}$ on $54$ combinations --- every object the
chain consumes downstream is a ratio of equally-homogeneous forms, hence no
fifth device can come from a sector change ($\rho=1.0036$--$1.0140>1$ flat,
T161, quoted and untouched). The one genuinely new item is \textbf{R-F}: is
there a $v$ with $Q(v)/\mathrm{TV}(v)>2\kappa$ \emph{and} $Q(v)$ comparable to
$1/s$ --- equivalently, can the alignment efficiency $\eta$ stay above
$2\kappa/\|C\|_\infty$ at bounded price? No sector, no normalisation, no
prime. Stress: the uniform surrogate breaks by
$1.5\times10^{3}$--$4.9\times10^{7}$, the T145 no-go staircase is monotone
($1.0\to9.1\to25.4\to129\to434$, exact null control at $\nu=4$, damage

$3.4\times10^{-2}$, Dirichlet/parity/orthonormality controls

% Original source: changelog.tex:3020-3128 at ba2f0fc; exact block follows.
\subsection*{\interlinepenalty=150\relax 2026-07-29 (X) (\texttt{v555} --- the Pareto/total-variation identities of phase 2 promoted; prime-front diary T163 (the front resists as a theorem --- the $h^2$ is the parity spectral gap, not the primes, FRONT-RESISTS) + paper + website sync; NO marker moves)}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.5em]
\item \textbf{New module \texttt{v555} (\texttt{PRIME.PARETO.TV.01}).} Promotion of
the closed theorem cores of the discovery parts T162 (\texttt{third\_split\_probe.py})
and T163 (\texttt{pareto\_front\_probe.py}) --- $23$ checks, ${\sim}0.4$\,s, everything
recomputed on \texttt{v551}--\texttt{v554}'s declared surface (the $12$ deepest
prime-power zones admitting a frame-A window inside the cap, $n=29\ldots139$,
$m=96\ldots291\le300$), with the one arithmetic input $\kappa=0.038821$
\emph{verified} at every jump point of $\psi(x)/x$ on the von-Mangoldt table in
$[100,3.2\times10^{5}]$ (Chebyshev 1852 / Rosser--Schoenfeld 1962, reproduced to
$4.2\times10^{-7}$), nothing cited from the sandbox; the companion to \texttt{v554},
which certified what the sixteen-form \emph{pairs against} --- this module certifies
the \emph{price structure} of that pairing. Scope fence: per-instance identities and
certified inequalities with the direction in the name --- no fit, no $D$-exponent, no
zone-uniform statement; the T163 $h$-exponents ($P_{\mathrm{aff}}\sim h^{3.05}$,
$P_{\mathrm{cross}}\sim h^{1.91}$, the TV exponent $\sim h^{2.00}$) are sandbox fits
and are \emph{not} consumed; finite $\Lambda$-sums are allowed and used, \emph{no RH
statement} is made ($\tfrac12$ appears in exactly one role: as the strength of a
classical statement a required depth is compared against); the open terms after T163
(R-E the successor with both arms prime-free; R-B$'''$ the $h$-uniform positivity
margin; R-D a fifth R1$''$ device) stay open and typed open; each statement carries at
least one mutation control that must fail loudly.
\item \textbf{(1) The exchange law and the crossing criterion (T163, R1.2) \mE.}
$\delta_{\mathrm{bnd}}(x)=\tfrac12+\log(2\kappa\,g_{16}\,\mathrm{TV}(x)/P(x))/\log X$
is an \emph{identity} at all $612$ grid points of the declared Fej\'er knob ($50$
geometric $\sigma$ on $[1,4096]$ plus $\infty$, $12$ windows; $5.1\times10^{-16}$
relative, admissibility $Q(x)>0$ everywhere), and the crossing criterion
$\delta_{\mathrm{bnd}}<\tfrac12\iff P>2\kappa g_{16}\mathrm{TV}$ holds as an exact
equivalence at every point --- price and demand are two coordinates of \emph{one}
object. Mutation: the wrong constant moves the law by $6.5\times10^{-2}$--$3.4$.
\item \textbf{(2) The total-variation floor (T163, R2.2) \mE.} (T1)
$w_0(x)=\|a(x)\|^2$ ($4.9\times10^{-16}$); (T2) $\mathrm{TV}(x)\ge|w_0(x)|$ by
telescoping with $w_M=0$; (T3) $x_1=1$ forces $\|a\|^2\ge1/\mu^P_1$, hence
$\mu^P_1\,\mathrm{TV}(x)=5.00$--$28.84\ge1$ on all $708$ trial vectors built, against
the closed floor $1/\mu^P_1=1/(4\sin^2(\pi/N))=943.6$--$8609.6\sim h^2$; (T4) every
sub-$\tfrac12$ grid point pays $P>2\kappa g_{16}/\mu^P_1=15.4$--$142.8$ (all $54$
respect it) --- a flat-price sub-$\tfrac12$ demand is impossible in the parity sector
on this surface: \textbf{R-C$'''$ is closed negatively, by an inequality}. Negative
control: the \emph{inadmissible} vector $0.01x^*$ undercuts the floor
($2.5$--$2.9\times10^{-3}$) and is recognised --- the floor is a property of the
normalisation meeting the smallest parity eigenvalue (Kac--Murdock--Szeg\H{o} 1953).
\item \textbf{(3) The chain-derived price axis (T163, R1.0) \mE.} $\sigma=1$ gives
$x=e_1$ exactly with $P=g_{16}/g_1$ (the $K=1$ rung of the T158 Cholesky ladder, the
T157 route-(0) certificate; $4.1\times10^{-16}$), $\sigma=\infty$ gives
$g_{16}Q(x^*)=1$ (the $K=16$ top rung; $1.2\times10^{-12}$); the ladder carries all
$16$ terms strictly positive with monotone partial sums, the knob is monotone in both
coordinates on every window (the knob curve \emph{is} the Pareto front). Mutation: a
corrupted sixteen-block makes the Cholesky \emph{refuse} on $12/12$.
\item \textbf{(4) The Mellin cell moments and the Abel step (T162, C2/C5) \mE.} The
$k$-th Mellin rung $\sum_dw_dC_d(-(2k+\tfrac12))$ with $C_d(s)$ the closed tent
integral (Mellin 1896) agrees with an independent per-cell Gauss--Legendre quadrature
to $2.8\times10^{-13}$ on every rung $k=1\ldots4$ (shifted tent centres break by
$\ge1.3\times10^{-2}$); the boundary-free Abel identities hold at levels $k=1\ldots3$
($8.3\times10^{-17}$; Abel 1826), the dropped-boundary level-$1$ form agrees because
the gauge identity kills the boundary term exactly, the optimal level is \emph{one}
for T162's closed reason ($32\pi/\alpha=40.6$--$59.4>1$, measured ratio
$30.8$--$69.1$), and a gauge violation breaks by its closed prediction $v_0c_0M$ to
$1.2\times10^{-15}$ (the positive control).
\item \textbf{(5) The Lerch/Frullani log-moment (T162, R-A$'$) \mE.}
$L=\sum_d\Psi_dw_d$ agrees on three routes per window: direct; double-Abel \emph{with}
the Wronskian boundary term ($2.8\times10^{-14}$; dropping it breaks by
$2.2\times10^{-4}$--$1.3\times10^{-2}$); the Lerch/Frullani integral with the $d=1$
term peeled closed ($1.8\times10^{-15}$) --- the peel constant $2\log2$ reproduced to
$2.2\times10^{-16}$ and $\Psi_1=-\log2$ exactly (Frullani 1828 / Lerch 1887 / Clausen
1832). Plus the monotone no-go staircase (damage $1.00\to3.49\to10.81\to24.98$ over
$\nu=4/2/1/0.5$, exact null control) and exact Dirichlet/parity controls.
\item \textbf{Prime-front diary T163 (\texttt{pareto\_front\_probe.py}, contract
\texttt{PARETO.FRONT}, $32/32$, $1.9$\,s, $28$ log-spaced prime-power zones
$h=142\ldots1445$ with declared caps, $27$ windows inside the cond horizon, verdict
FRONT-RESISTS, sandbox).} The survey of the Pareto front, and the front resists
\emph{as a theorem}: the price axis is chain-derived ($P_{\mathrm{aff}}=g_{16}B_{11}
\sim h^{+3.049}$, the T157 route-(0) certificate), the Fej\'er knob has both endpoints
in the chain and is measured monotone in both coordinates (the knob curve \emph{is}
the front), no flat price crosses the yardstick ($0/27$ at caps $1.25/2/10$ and every
flat rung tier; only the full $P_{\mathrm{aff}}$ reaches $27/27$), the crossing price
$P_{\mathrm{cross}}\sim h^{+1.906}$ sits at $0.0066$--$0.2047$ of $P_{\mathrm{aff}}$
--- $5$--$152\times$ strictly inside the already-accepted certificate, margin widening
--- and the price anatomy is an \emph{identity}:
$\delta_{\mathrm{bnd}}=\tfrac12+\log(2\kappa g_{16}\mathrm{TV}/P)/\log X$ exactly at
all $27\times50$ grid points, the crossing exponent decomposing additively (TV
$+2.013$, $g_{16}$ $-0.061$). The four-line theorem (T1--T4) gives every admissible
trial vector the total-variation floor $\mathrm{TV}\ge1/\mu^P_1\sim h^2$ (verified on
all $1674$ built, slack $5.0$--$23.2$), so the crossing price is bounded below by a
quantity growing like $h^2$: the $h^{2.86}$ of T162, the $h^{1.91}$ of the crossing
and T161's granularity are \emph{all} the reciprocal smallest parity eigenvalue ---
\textbf{the spectral gap of the parity Laplacian meeting the entry normalisation
$x_1=1$: it was never in the primes}. The mode sweep $K=16\to64$ confirms it from the
other side (price dividend, worse demand, TV exponent unmoved at $h^{+1.81}$); R-B$''$
reduces to an $h$-uniformity question (the chain never needed the sign: duality plus
an evaluated number, headroom $\ge10^{14.9}$); R-D is a type mismatch (operator
smoothing degrades the floor by the same $h^2$). Balance $11/1/4/10$, zero fit rows.
T164 (\texttt{sector\_change\_probe.py}), running, tests the successor R-E. NOT RH
evidence; no marker moves.
\item \textbf{Docs + website sync.} \texttt{tfpt\_prime\_front} gains the T163
subsection with the exchange-law display, the T1--T4 floor theorem as the key result,
the chain-derived price axis, the monotone no-go staircase and the After-T163 keybox
(R-E/R-B$'''$/R-D, T164 running), the \texttt{v555} subsection in the verified layer
(now twenty-one modules), the phase-2 section retitled T126--T163, the T163 row in the
probe index and the updated counters ($163$ probes, $4267$ checks);
\texttt{tfpt\_1}, \texttt{tfpt\_3} and \texttt{tfpt\_research\_contracts} gain the
\texttt{v555} companion blocks; \texttt{experiments/next.txt} gains the Teil-163
entry; \texttt{website/lib/primeFront.ts} gains the T163 and \texttt{v555} feed
entries; the prime-front status surfaces move to Teile 11--163 / $4267$ checks / 21
modules (\texttt{v535}--\texttt{v555}); suite counter $548\to549$ scripts. T164
(\texttt{sector\_change\_probe.py}) is running at the sector-change successor. Ledger
row \texttt{PRIME.PARETO.TV.01} \mE; \textbf{no marker of any pre-existing contract
moves}.
\end{itemize}


% Original source: changelog.tex:3129-3236 at ba2f0fc; exact block follows.
\subsection*{\interlinepenalty=150\relax 2026-07-29 (IX) (\texttt{v554} --- the sampling/harmonics identities of phase 2 promoted; prime-front diary T161 (the circularity triage: the hardness sits in the split, not in the primes, CLOSURE-RESISTS) + paper + website sync; NO marker moves)}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.5em]
\item \textbf{New module \texttt{v554} (\texttt{PRIME.SAMPLING.HARM.01}).} Promotion of
the closed theorem cores of the discovery parts T160 (\texttt{pairing\_probe.py}) and
T161 (\texttt{classical\_closure\_probe.py}) --- $21$ checks, ${\sim}0.5$\,s, everything
recomputed on \texttt{v551}--\texttt{v553}'s declared surface (the $12$ deepest
prime-power zones admitting a frame-A window inside the cap, $n=29\ldots139$,
$m=96\ldots291\le300$) plus a declared $\Lambda$-battery of six log-spaced cut-offs
$X=10^{3}\ldots3.2\times10^{5}$ for the PNT item (finite von-Mangoldt sums only, no
matrix anywhere), nothing cited from the sandbox; the companion to \texttt{v553}, which
certified the algebra of the sixteen-form --- this module certifies \emph{what that form
pairs against}, and it closes no open term. Scope fence: per-instance identities and
certified inequalities with the direction in the name --- no fit, no $D$-exponent, no
zone-uniform statement; finite $\Lambda$-sums are allowed and used, \emph{no RH
statement} is made, and the $\delta$ triage of T161 (required cancellation depth against
RH strength) is a documentation item, \emph{not} a module claim; the open terms after
T161 (R-A$'$ the prime-free log-moment; R-B$'$ the $m$-free $16\times16$ Gram fraction
bound; R-C$'$ one split of the pairing with $\delta_{\mathrm{eff}}<\tfrac12$; R-D a
fifth R1$''$ device) stay open and typed open; each statement carries at least one
mutation control that must fail loudly.
\item \textbf{(1) The sampling identity (T160, P2) \mE.} The atom half of the pairing
equals $-\tfrac12\sum_{n\le X}(2\Lambda(n)/\sqrt n)\,\widehat w(\log n)$ (plus one
reflected term below the grid; $\widehat w$ the linear interpolant of the lag weights),
exact to $5.6\times10^{-15}$ of the absolute atom scale on $12/12$ windows: identically
a finite combination of sums $\sum_n\Lambda(n)n^{-1/2}\cos(t\log n)$ at $32$ explicit
frequencies. Mutation: a one-index grid shift breaks by
$5.1\times10^{-5}$--$3.1\times10^{-3}$.
\item \textbf{(2) The moment laws and the TV theorem (T160, P1/P4) \mE.} $m_0=0$
($1.0\times10^{-16}$ of $\|w\|_1$), $m_1=-[S_0^2+2\sum_jP_j^2]$ ($9.2\times10^{-16}$)
and $m_2=-[2S_1-(M{-}1)S_0]^2$ ($3.4\times10^{-14}$, a perfect square), both strictly
negative on every window; U3 as a theorem with \emph{checked} hypotheses
($c^{\mathrm{arch}}\le0$ and monotone on $d\ge1$, $12/12$):
$\mathrm{TV}(c^{\mathrm{arch}})=3.9817$--$4.8991\le|c_0|+2\sup<6$, closed and
window-independent. Mutations: a one-index prefix shift breaks $m_1$ by
$\ge1.25\times10^{-2}$, an $(M{-}2)$ mis-normalisation breaks $m_2$ by
$\ge6.1\times10^{-2}$, the full atom-including kernel violates the monotone hypothesis
on $12/12$.
\item \textbf{(3) The harmonic-frequency theorem and the PNT main term (T161, P3) \mE.}
$t_j(2\alpha)=2\pi j$ \emph{exactly} ($2.8\times10^{-14}$) on every window and every
battery cut-off --- the $32$ frequencies of the sampling identity are precisely the
Fourier harmonics of the log-window $[0,2\alpha]$; at those frequencies
$\theta=2\pi j$ collapses the partial-summation main term to the closed, parameter-free
prediction $(\sqrt X-1)/(\tfrac14+t^2)$ (de la Vall\'ee Poussin 1896; the Mellin factor
of $x^{-1/2}$), matching the finite sums to $0.0007$--$0.097$ of the trivial mass
against the declared cap $0.12$, the subtraction reducing the aggregate residual to
$0.008$--$0.466\le0.5$ on every cut-off. Mutations: a wrong Mellin pole worsens the
aggregate residual by $\times1.8$--$\times95.8$; a mass-matched \emph{uniform} fake
measure misses by $0.23$--$0.51$ --- the agreement is a property of the von-Mangoldt
measure, not of any measure with the same mass.
\item \textbf{(4) The head split and the scale-free Bernstein rate (T161, P1) \mE.}
$c^{\mathrm{arch}}_d=\Psi_d+D\widehat G(dD,D)$ with
$\Psi_d=-\tfrac12[(d{+}1)\log(d{+}1)-2d\log d+(d{-}1)\log(d{-}1)]$ closed, $D$-free and
$m$-free (the triangle-smeared simple pole; the $\log D$ cancels identically), exact to
$3.2\times10^{-16}$ of $\sup|c^{\mathrm{arch}}|$ at \emph{every} lag of every window,
the two $\Psi$ representations agreeing to $2.9\times10^{-14}$; and
$\rho^*=(3+\sqrt5)/2=2.618034$: the root of $x^2-3x+1$, returned exactly by the $D\to0$
limit of the peeled interval $[0.4\alpha,2\alpha]$ and invariant under
$\alpha\times10$ --- scale-free, every window's $\rho(D)=2.588$--$2.608$ below it
(Bernstein 1912). Mutations: dropping $\Psi$ misses $c^{\mathrm{arch}}$ by
$0.99$--$1.00$; the wrong interval ratio moves the limit to $3.0$.
\item \textbf{(5) The off-diagonal fraction bound and the sign refutation (T161, P2)
\mE.} The gauge identity licenses one boundary-free Abel step,
$Q^{\mathrm{arch}}=\sum_{k,l}a_ka_l\sum_{d\ge1}(\Delta c^{\mathrm{arch}})_dR^1_{kl}(d)$
exactly ($2.0\times10^{-13}$), and the certified per-window inequality is
$|\text{off-diagonal block}|\le\tfrac14|Q^{\mathrm{arch}}|$ (measured $0.171$--$0.212$
on $12/12$) --- with the \emph{refuted} sign law wired as the negative control: the
arch half is negative while its off-diagonal block is positive on $12/12$, and
$176/240$ off-diagonal pairs violate the per-pair form on every window --- nothing
single-signed is promoted. Mutation: a one-index $R$-kernel shift breaks by
$\ge6.8\times10^{-5}$. Stress: the head split misses the T145 no-go reconstruction by
$2.39$; the Dirichlet cosine-sum identity (including the degenerate branch), the KMS
eigenpairs and $\mathrm{odd\_toeplitz}(c^L)=L_P$ (zero tolerance) are exact.
\item \textbf{Prime-front diary T161 (\texttt{classical\_closure\_probe.py}, contract
\texttt{CLASSICAL.CLOSURE}, $35/35$, $1.2$\,s, $19$ log-spaced prime-power zones
$h=50\ldots1445$, verdict CLOSURE-RESISTS, triage verdict NEEDS-BEYOND-RH-STRENGTH,
sandbox).} The two classical rests plus the circularity triage, and the triage returns
its most consequential answer: \emph{the chain is not circular}. R-A closes $m$-free ---
$A=D\widehat A$ exactly, only the $1/s$ head binds, the scale-free Bernstein rate
$\rho^*=(3+\sqrt5)/2$, the closed head split (no peeling), and an explicit degree
schedule $K(h)=O(\log h)$ (a \emph{fixed} degree is refuted with a number; the residual
is the prime-free log-moment, outside the polynomial ladder). R-B is refuted in all four
readings ($3168/4320$ pairs; the aggregate by \emph{sign}) and replaced by the certified
fraction bound $0.1035$--$0.1713\le\tfrac14$, flat. The triage: the $32$ frequencies are
exactly the Fourier harmonics of the log-window (theorem), the measured cancellation is
fully the PNT main term, and the required depth is $\delta=1.1482$--$1.8809$ against RH
strength $\tfrac12$ --- in absolute terms $0.012$--$0.31$ of the last term of the sum,
below the boundary term of every partial summation, so no strengthening of the
$\psi(x)-x$ input reaches it: the chain needs \emph{more} than RH-strength input would
supply, which localises the $h^2$ in the \emph{split} rather than in the primes; a
re-split moves the demand to $\delta_{\mathrm{eff}}=0.9839$--$1.3767$ --- it moves, but
stays above $\tfrac12$ on $18/18$. Balance $20/10/4/9/3$. T162
(\texttt{third\_split\_probe.py}), running, searches for one split with
$\delta_{\mathrm{eff}}<\tfrac12$. NOT RH evidence; no marker moves.
\item \textbf{Docs + website sync.} \texttt{tfpt\_prime\_front} gains the T161
subsection with the $\delta$ table, the head-split display and the After-T161 keybox,
the \texttt{v554} subsection in the verified layer (now twenty modules), the phase-2
section retitled T126--T161, the T161 row in the probe index and the updated counters
($161$ probes, $4205$ checks); the big-picture section states the split-design reading
soberly; \texttt{tfpt\_1}, \texttt{tfpt\_3} and \texttt{tfpt\_research\_contracts} gain
the \texttt{v554} companion blocks; \texttt{experiments/next.txt} gains the Teil-161
entry; \texttt{website/lib/primeFront.ts} gains the T161 and \texttt{v554} feed entries;
the prime-front status surfaces move to Teile 11--161 / $4205$ checks / 20 modules
(\texttt{v535}--\texttt{v554}); suite counter $547\to548$ scripts. T162
(\texttt{third\_split\_probe.py}) is running at the third-split search. Ledger row
\texttt{PRIME.SAMPLING.HARM.01} \mE; \textbf{no marker of any pre-existing contract
moves}.
\end{itemize}


% Original source: changelog.tex:3237-3344 at ba2f0fc; exact block follows.
\subsection*{\interlinepenalty=150\relax 2026-07-29 (VIII) (\texttt{v553} --- the exact-form identities of phase 2 promoted; prime-front diary T159 (the gauge identity and the Z-matrix law, cancellation is the weight, FORM-RESISTS) + paper + website sync; NO marker moves)}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.5em]
\item \textbf{New module \texttt{v553} (\texttt{PRIME.EXACT.FORM.IDENT.01}).} Promotion of
the theorem cores of the discovery parts T158 (\texttt{schur\_entry\_probe.py}) and T159
(\texttt{exact\_form\_probe.py}) --- $25$ checks, ${\sim}0.2$\,s, everything recomputed on
\texttt{v551}/\texttt{v552}'s declared surface (the $12$ deepest prime-power zones
admitting a frame-A window inside the cap, $n=29\ldots139$, $m=96\ldots291\le300$; no-go
ladders $m=48\ldots288$ on \emph{both} T145 forms; parity and Dirichlet controls at
$m=64,128,256$), nothing cited from the sandbox; the companion to \texttt{v552}, which
certified the four angle instruments --- this module certifies the \emph{algebra of the
sixteen-form itself}, and it closes neither open term. Scope fence: per-instance
identities and certified inequalities with the direction in the name --- no fit, no
$D$-exponent, no zone-uniform statement, and explicitly \emph{no statement for all $D$}
(the two open terms after T159 --- the one explicit pairing inequality for R2$''$, needing
a correlation bound instead of sizes; a third device for the atom off-band block for
R1$''$ --- stay open and typed open); each statement carries at least one mutation
control that must fail loudly.
\item \textbf{(1) The Thomson dual form and the positive Cholesky ladder (T158, P1) \mE.}
$s=(B^{-1})_{11}=\max_x(2x_1-x^{\mathsf T}Bx)$ (Maz'ya 1985 / Miclo 1999) with the
direction \emph{executed}, not asserted: $8$ random trial vectors per window never exceed
$s$, so every trial is an upper bound on $1/s$ --- exactly the variational structure
Cauchy--Schwarz lacks (\texttt{v552} wired that refutation as a control; here the
direction itself is the check). The ladder $g_K=\sum_{j\le K}y_j^2$, $y=L^{-1}e_1$ from
\emph{one} Cholesky of the leading $16\times16$ block: all terms strictly positive,
partial sums strictly monotone, $1/s\le1/g_{16}\le1/g_1=B_{11}$ literally on $12/12$,
tight to $1.0642$--$1.1522$ against the declared cap $1.5$ (T158 measured $\le1.2738$ at
$h=254\ldots1393$, sandbox); mutation: a $5\%$ corruption of one off-diagonal entry
destroys positive definiteness --- the Cholesky \emph{refuses} on $12/12$.
\item \textbf{(2) The two-dimensionality (T158, P2) \mE.}
$\mathrm{span}\{t_1,A^{-1}L_Pt_1\}$ attains $s$ exactly ($g/s=1$ to $9.0\times10^{-13}$ on
$12/12$) for the theorem reason $L_Pt_1=\mu^P_1t_1$ (KMS 1953, eigenpair residual
$8.1\times10^{-13}$): the entry is a two-dimensional quantity the moment one Green column
is granted. Negative controls: the two-sine span (no Green column) misses by
$1.42$--$4.8$, the corrupted Green column (no solve) by $255$--$7.7\times10^{3}$.
\item \textbf{(3) The gauge identity and the TmH signature (T159, P4/P7) \mE.} The
reflection-odd section $A_{rs}=c_{|r-s|}-c_{M-1-r-s}$ annihilates constant lag vectors
\emph{entrywise with zero tolerance} ($\mathrm{odd\_toeplitz}(\mathbf 1)=0$ exactly ---
the mechanism in one line), hence the gauge identity $\sum_dw_d=0$ holds to
$1.1\times10^{-14}$ of $\sup|w|$ for the per-window optimiser and $3$ random
sixteen-vectors: the form is \emph{blind} to the lag mass of $c$, and the lag mass is
exactly where the archimedean and atom halves of the sixteen-form are $h^2$-sized and
cancel. The premise --- the Toeplitz-minus-Hankel signature $A_{r,s}-A_{r+1,s+1}=f(r+s)$
--- holds to $1.4\times10^{-16}$. Mutations: a one-index Hankel shift breaks the identity
by $2.7\times10^{-7}$--$4.2\times10^{-5}$; the T145 form $R=aa^{\mathsf T}+\varepsilon I$
has signature defect $7.4\times10^{-2}$ --- not a parity section, the gauge identity is
not even \emph{defined} for it.
\item \textbf{(4) The exact lag sum and the two closed scalars (T159, P2/P5) \mE.}
$x^{\mathsf T}B_{LL}x=\sum_dc_dw_d$ with $w_d=T_d-H_d$ against the direct assembly to
$2.7\times10^{-16}$ of the absolute scale $\sum_d|c_dw_d|$ --- and the honest price
\emph{measured}: relative to the cancelled total the same identity holds only to
$1.4\times10^{-11}$ on this small surface (the sandbox at $h\le1293$ loses $4.0$--$8.1$
digits; that depth \emph{is} the $h^2$ obstruction). The two closed scalars:
$w_0=\sum_kx_k^2/\mu^P_k$ (the $N^2/4\pi^2$ factor itself) to $4.2\times10^{-16}$ and
$2w_0-w_1=\|x\|^2$ to $7.4\times10^{-16}$ (KMS 1953). Mutations: a $1\%$ perturbation of
the largest lag breaks the lag sum by $2.2\times10^{-3}$; a one-index $\mu$ shift breaks
$w_0$ by $0.60$.
\item \textbf{(5) The Z-matrix law and the Collatz--Wielandt floor (T159, U1/U2) \mE.}
$B^{\mathrm{arch}}_{HH}$ is a symmetric Z-matrix \emph{raw} --- every off-diagonal entry
$\le0$ with no tolerance on $12/12$; the closed sign-based floor
$\min_k(B^{\mathrm{arch}}_{HH}\mathbf 1)_k=0.9093$--$1.1284\ge t=0.25$ with the theorem
direction verified per instance against the exact
$\lambda_{\min}(B^{\mathrm{arch}}_{HH})=0.9138$--$1.1432$ (Perron 1907 / Frobenius 1912 /
Collatz 1942 / Wielandt 1950), beating the sign-free norm route by $0.69$--$8.8$ on every
window. The honest limit as content: the atom block obeys \emph{no} sign law
($0.44$--$0.53$, a coin toss), the full block is not a Z-matrix and its row-sum floor is
\emph{negative} ($-48.3\ldots-0.79$) against a positive exact bottom --- admissible and
vacuous, R1$''$ stays open. Mutation: the checkerboard similarity
$S=\mathrm{diag}((-1)^k)$ --- an isometry, $\lambda_{\min}$ moves by $0$ exactly ---
destroys the raw law (fraction $1.0000\to0.494$--$0.498$): the Z law is an entrywise
fact, not a spectral one, and T159's checkerboard reading (S2) is refuted. Stress: the
T145 no-go breaks on three axes of this module's structure; on the $c(l)=1/(1+l)$
reconstruction the ladder theorem survives while $1/g_{16}$ explodes
($1187\to7.11\times10^{4}$) --- the instrument reports the collapse instead of hiding it;
parity: for $A=L_P$ the machinery returns $s=1$ with every ladder partial sum constant in
$K$; Dirichlet controls exact.
\item \textbf{Prime-front diary T159 (\texttt{exact\_form\_probe.py}, contract
\texttt{EXACT.FORM}, $41/41$, $2.9$\,s, $23$ of $24$ prime-power zones $h=142\ldots1293$,
the sign surface on $18$ windows $h=142\ldots963$, verdict FORM-RESISTS, sandbox).} The
cancellation executed algebraically: seven machine-checked identities to $10^{-12}$
against the absolute scale (the cancellation eats $4.0$--$8.1$ decimal digits, reported
as a measurement), among them the closed $256$-term Dirichlet-kernel form of the
geometric weights and the \emph{gauge identity} $\sum_dw_d=0$ exactly --- the form is
blind to the lag mass, exactly where the $h^2$ halves live. The honest core answer is
negative: the $h^2$ does \emph{not} telescope away, it is the common \emph{weight} of
both halves (both grow $h^{+2.104}$), and four routes are closed with exponents ---
T158's own fixed sixteen-vector refuted at $h^{+3.510}$, one sine at $h^{+3.066}$, the
preregistered ansatz family at $h^{+3.001}$, Abel-$\ell^1\times\sup$ at every rung (best
$h^{+3.604}$). The structural win: $B^{\mathrm{arch}}_{HH}$ is exactly a symmetric
Z-matrix with a closed sign-based Collatz--Wielandt floor $0.819$--$1.165$ comfortably
above $t=0.25$ --- but the atom block obeys no sign law, and the full-block criterion is
vacuous. Balance $6/3/4/1\to13$ theorem / $6$ cert-unif / $4$ cert-window / $1$ measured;
a numerical horizon declared as its own measurement ($\mathrm{cond}(B_{LL})>10^{12}$ from
$h=1292$); one fully explicit pairing inequality remains, under attack via correlation
structure in T160 (\texttt{pairing\_probe.py}), running. NOT RH evidence; no marker moves.
\item \textbf{Docs + website sync.} \texttt{tfpt\_prime\_front} gains the T159 subsection
with the After-T159 keybox, the \texttt{v553} subsection in the verified layer (now
nineteen modules), the phase-2 section retitled T126--T159, the T159 row in the probe
index and the updated counters ($159$ probes, $4124$ checks); \texttt{tfpt\_1},
\texttt{tfpt\_3} and \texttt{tfpt\_research\_contracts} gain the \texttt{v553} companion
blocks; \texttt{experiments/next.txt} gains the Teil-159 entry;
\texttt{website/lib/primeFront.ts} gains the T159 and \texttt{v553} feed entries; the
prime-front status surfaces move to Teile 11--159 / $4124$ checks / 19 modules
(\texttt{v535}--\texttt{v553}); suite counter $546\to547$ scripts. T160
(\texttt{pairing\_probe.py}) is running at the pairing bound. Ledger row
\texttt{PRIME.EXACT.FORM.IDENT.01} \mE; \textbf{no marker of any pre-existing contract
moves}.
\end{itemize}
