\subsection*{\interlinepenalty=150\relax 2026-07-29 (VII) (\texttt{v552} --- the four fixed-size angle instruments of phase 2 promoted; prime-front diary T157 (the confinement theorem and the one-entry reduction, ANGLES-RESIST) + paper + website sync; NO marker moves)}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.5em]
\item \textbf{New module \texttt{v552} (\texttt{PRIME.ANGLE.INSTR.01}).} Promotion of the
instrument cores of the discovery parts T155 (\texttt{bottom\_floor\_probe.py}) and T157
(\texttt{angle\_floor\_probe.py}) --- $18$ checks, ${\sim}0.4$\,s, everything recomputed on
\texttt{v551}'s declared surface (the $12$ deepest prime-power zones admitting a frame-A
window inside the cap, $n=29\ldots139$, $m=96\ldots291\le300$; a no-go size ladder
$m=48\ldots288$; parity and Dirichlet controls at $m=64,128,256$), nothing cited from the
sandbox; the companion to \texttt{v551}, which certified the fixed-size ceiling step ---
this module certifies the four fixed-size \emph{instruments} the angle campaign produced,
and none of them closes an angle. Scope fence: per-instance identities and certified
inequalities with the direction in the name --- no fit, no $D$-exponent, no zone-uniform
statement, and explicitly \emph{no statement for all $D$} (the two open terms after T157
--- an $m$-free lower bound on $\hat g_1^2$, equivalently an $m$-free upper bound on the
one Schur diagonal entry $1/s$; and an $m$-free R1$''$ domination with a non-shrinking
margin --- stay open and typed open); each statement carries at least one mutation control
that must fail loudly.
\item \textbf{(1) The complement-floor certificate (T155) \mE.}
$\min_{v\perp W}v^{\mathsf T}L_Pv\ge\mu^P_{13}-\lambda_{\max}(M^{1/2}(I-GG^{\mathsf T})
M^{1/2})$ with $M=\mathrm{diag}(\mu^P_{13}-\mu^P_k)$ and $G=T_{12}Q_W$ --- an identity
plus \emph{one} certified Rayleigh bound on the high block, a theorem for every $m$ and
every subspace, direction checked: the certificate never exceeds the exact size-$m$
complement bottom ($12/12$) and agrees to $1-\mathrm{ratio}\le1.01\times10^{-3}$ against
the declared cap $2\times10^{-3}$ on this small surface (T155 measured
$\le2.2\times10^{-7}$ at $h=142\ldots1293$, sandbox). Exactness controls both ways:
$W=\mathrm{span}\{t_1..t_8\}$ returns $\mu^P_9$ and the \emph{worthless} configuration
$W=\mathrm{span}\{t_2..t_{13}\}$ returns $\mu^P_1$, both to $2.0\times10^{-11}$ --- the
instrument reports its own worthlessness; mutation: one corrupted overlap row moves the
certificate by $\ge0.549$, only downward.
\item \textbf{(2) The sine-block confinement (T157) \mE.} From the certified pencil floor
$A\succeq tL_P$ and the certified ladder ceiling $\lambda_1\le S\mu^P_1$ \emph{alone},
$\|\gamma_H\|^2\le\lambda_1/(t\,\mu^P_{17})\le(S/t)/\rho_{17}=0.0153$--$0.0245<1$ on
$12/12$: the bottom eigenvector lives $97.5$--$98.5\%$ inside the first $16$ parity sines
by a \emph{per-instance theorem} (measured tail $6.7\times10^{-6}$--$3.0\times10^{-5}$;
T146's measured ``$98$ per cent'' replaced by one line). Negative control: the pencil
ceiling $\kappa$ in place of the ladder $S$ makes the bound vacuous ($17.6$--$477>1$ on
$12/12$); mutation: the inflated floor $\kappa L_P$ is refuted at $e_1(A)$ by
$3.3\times10^{3}$--$1.0\times10^{5}$.
\item \textbf{(3) The Schur-entry identity (T157) \mE.}
$s=\mu^P_1\,t_1^{\mathsf T}A^{-1}t_1=(B^{-1})_{11}$ exactly ($1.1\times10^{-11}$) and
$(B^{-1})_{LL}S_L=I$ to $5.8\times10^{-11}$ with $S_L=B_{LL}-B_{LH}B_{HH}^{-1}B_{HL}$ the
\emph{same} fixed-size $16\times16$ Schur complement the chain already forms:
$1/s=4.0460$--$5.8962$ is an $O(1)$ number carried by \emph{one} entry, so T156's R2$''$
loss ceiling $r\le1/(Ls)$ is a statement about one number. Negative control (T157's
refutation wired as a check): the inversion-free Cauchy--Schwarz ceiling is valid and
useless, off by $250$--$7.27\times10^{3}$ --- the cancellation in
$b^{\mathsf T}B_{HH}^{-1}b$ is nearly complete and Cauchy--Schwarz cannot see it;
mutation: a one-index shift breaks the identity by $1.55$--$2.15$.
\item \textbf{(4) The adaptive Lipschitz ceiling (T157) \mE.} Interval bisection with the
\emph{local} Lipschitz constant certifies
$\inf f^{\mathrm{arch}}/(4\sin^2(\theta/2))\ge0.25$ on $12/12$ windows in $519$--$1201$
symbol evaluations (certified floor $0.2505$--$0.3062$, never above the fine-grid
minimum); the global constant is documented insufficient (a uniform grid would need up to
$61.4\times$ more points); mutation: fed a target above the true grid minimum the
certificate \emph{refuses} on $12/12$. Stress: on the T145 no-go family the Schur floor
survives ($t=0.05$) while the confinement goes vacuous ($\times52.0$) and $(S_L)_{11}$
explodes ($\times60.0$) against the flat real band; parity control exact to
$4.9\times10^{-14}$; the Dirichlet residual hits the predicted $2/\sqrt N$ to
$7.4\times10^{-5}$.
\item \textbf{Prime-front diary T157 (\texttt{angle\_floor\_probe.py}, contract
\texttt{ANGLE.FLOOR}, $32/32$, $3.9$\,s, $16$ prime-power windows $h=142\ldots1293$, the
alignment surface on $12$ ($h=50\ldots1077$), verdict ANGLES-RESIST, sandbox).} Neither
angle falls, but both change shape: the $p_1$ floor becomes a theorem times one measured
fixed-size number --- the sine-block confinement
$\|\gamma_H\|^2\le(S/t)/\rho_{17}=0.0165$--$0.0293$ proves $e_1(A)$ lives
$97.1$--$98.4\%$ inside the first sixteen parity sines, and the resolvent route pins
$p_1\ge\hat g_1^2(1-\mathrm{tail})=0.1968$--$0.3228$, $97.9\%$ of the measurement (the
classical Rayleigh angle bound is empty on $16/16$, its block version empty at every $J$,
the angle-free Cauchy--Schwarz route loses exactly the Kantorovich
$P=5.6\times10^{2}$--$1.0\times10^{6}$); the structural gem
$1/s=(S_L)_{11}=2.3359$--$6.2049$ flat makes the whole first term a bound on \emph{one}
diagonal entry of the $16\times16$ Schur complement the chain already forms
(Cauchy--Schwarz off by $5.4\times10^{2}$--$5.2\times10^{5}$); the arch half is uniformly
certified for the first time (executed adaptive Lipschitz ceiling, $12/12$, cost
$h^{0.85}$) with the two extremals at opposite ends of the band (the pointer: use the
$\theta$-growth, not the infimum at $\pi$); the alignment term stays a per-window
domination ($1.0003$--$1.0907$, margin $7.3\times10^{-4}$, shrinking trend); balance $9$
theorem / $2$ cert-unif / $2$ cert-window / $3$ measured (all three now fixed-size in the
statement); the no-go breaks on \emph{five} axes. T158 (\texttt{schur\_entry\_probe.py})
is running at the cancellation-seeing bound. NOT RH evidence; no marker moves.
\item \textbf{Docs + website sync.} \texttt{tfpt\_prime\_front} gains the T157 subsection
with the After-T157 keybox, the \texttt{v552} subsection in the verified layer (now
eighteen modules), the phase-2 section retitled T126--T157, the T157 row in the probe
index and the updated counters ($157$ probes, $4047$ checks); \texttt{tfpt\_1},
\texttt{tfpt\_3} and \texttt{tfpt\_research\_contracts} gain the \texttt{v552} companion
blocks; \texttt{experiments/next.txt} gains the Teil-157 entry;
\texttt{website/lib/primeFront.ts} gains the T157 and \texttt{v552} feed entries; the
prime-front status surfaces move to Teile 11--157 / $4047$ checks / 18 modules; suite
counter $545\to546$ scripts. T158 (\texttt{schur\_entry\_probe.py}) is running at the
cancellation-seeing bound. Ledger row \texttt{PRIME.ANGLE.INSTR.01} \mE; \textbf{no marker
of any pre-existing contract moves}.
\end{itemize}

\subsection*{\interlinepenalty=150\relax 2026-07-29 (VI) (\texttt{v551} --- the fixed-size Ritz ceiling certificate of phase 2 promoted; prime-front diary T154 (the ceiling closes exactly at fixed size, ALIGN-RESISTS) + paper + website sync; NO marker moves)}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.5em]
\item \textbf{New module \texttt{v551} (\texttt{PRIME.RITZ.CEIL.01}).} Promotion of the
certificate core of the discovery part T154 (\texttt{green\_align\_probe.py}) --- $16$ checks,
${\sim}0.4$\,s, everything recomputed on small frame-A windows, nothing cited from the sandbox;
the companion to \texttt{v550}, which certified the bottom ladder
$\lambda_k(A)\le S\mu^P_k$ by per-window LDL$^{\mathsf T}$ counts of \emph{size $m$} --- this
module certifies the \emph{fixed-size} replacement T154 found for the ceiling step. Scope
fence: per-instance theorems with checked hypotheses and per-window \emph{certified}
inequalities --- no fit, no $D$-exponent, no zone-uniform statement, and explicitly \emph{no
statement for all $D$} (the two open inputs after T154 --- R1$'$, an $m$-free floor for
$\lambda_{\min}(B_{HH})$ on the bulk parity block, and R2$'$, an $m$-free lower bound for the
$L_P$ floor on the complement of the eight bottom Ritz directions --- stay open and typed
open; every floor consumed is a per-window certificate of size $m$). Battery: the $12$
\emph{deepest} prime-power zones admitting a frame-A window inside the cap ($n=29\ldots139$,
$m=96\ldots291\le300$, $D=7.248\times10^{-3}\ldots1.815\times10^{-2}$ --- mirroring T154's own
surface selection, declared rather than tuned: on the shallowest zones $n\le11$ more than one
bottom direction leaves the sine block and the fixed-depth certificate is \emph{not} claimed
there), a no-go size ladder $m=48\ldots288$, parity controls at $m=64,128,256$, and $3$
Dirichlet control windows; each statement carries a mutation control that must fail by
$\ge10^{-3}$.
\item \textbf{(1) The direction lemma (T154) \mE.} For orthonormal $Q$ and
$W=Q^{\mathsf T}AQ$, $\lambda_k(A)\le\theta_k$ for \emph{every} $k\le\dim$ --- Ritz values are
\emph{upper} bounds for the eigenvalues of the \emph{same index} (Courant--Fischer 1920 /
Cauchy 1829), verified against the exact spectrum on the certificate subspace of every window
and on $24$ random subspaces (one-sided excess $0.0$) --- so the fixed-size ceiling needs
\emph{no} residual argument at all; Temple 1928 / Kato 1949 is a floor device and is used
nowhere in the module. Negative control: the \emph{reversed} reading (Ritz values as lower
bounds) is recognised as false on $12/12$ windows, $\theta_k$ overshooting $\lambda_k$ by a
factor $\ge18.6$ somewhere on every window.
\item \textbf{(2) The sixteen-column certificate (T154) \mE.}
$\mathrm{span}\{t_1..t_8\}+A^{-1}L_P\,\mathrm{span}\{t_1..t_8\}$ has \emph{fixed} dimension
$16$, independent of $m$ (one Green step by Cholesky back-solves, no inverse formed), and its
ceiling $K^F=\max_k\theta_k/\mu^P_k$ ($8$ completed Choleskys of matrices $\le8\times8$)
equals $1.1019$--$1.5845$ with $K^F\ge\max_k\lambda_k/\mu^P_k$ on every window \emph{and}
$|K^F/K_{\mathrm{bot}}-1|\le9.9\times10^{-7}$ against the declared cap $10^{-4}$ on $12/12$,
where $K_{\mathrm{bot}}$ is the inertia-certified true ladder constant ($8$ completed
LDL$^{\mathsf T}$ counts of size $m$ per window; count $=$ direct spectral count on all $96$
pairs): the fixed-size ceiling \emph{attains} the truth, and the size-$m$ counts are retired
from the ceiling step (controls: the parity sines alone overshoot by $41.6$--$739$ ---
T152/T153's $O(m^2)$ overshoot reproduced at fixed size --- and corrupting the Green columns
breaks the attainment on $12/12$).
\item \textbf{(3) The one-direction anatomy (T154) \mE\ (angles measured).} The median of the
seven aligned principal angles between the bottom eight of $A$ and the bottom eight of $L_P$
is $0.03$--$0.14^\circ$ while the largest is $83.79$--$89.70^\circ$ on every window
(Bj\"orck--Golub 1973) --- the misalignment is carried by \emph{one} nearly orthogonal
direction, and that single direction \emph{is} the collapse price
$\lambda_1(A)/(t\,\mu^P_1)=4.408$--$7.042$, recovered in full per window by one completed
Cholesky of $A-\gamma I$ (size $m$, certified, not fixed size, labelled as such); control:
$A=L_P$ through the same instrument returns $K_{\mathrm{bot}}=K^F=1$ and zero misalignment
(deviations $<10^{-5}$, the inertia ladder's backoff step) with the price exactly $1/t$.
\item \textbf{(4) The no-go discriminator (T154) \mE.} On the T145 no-go reconstruction
$c(l)=1/(1+l)$ the odd section is positive definite and the Schur floor survives ($t=0.05$ on
all $4$ sizes) but $K_{\mathrm{bot}}$ explodes ($\times35.4$) and the sixteen-column ceiling
explodes \emph{with} it ($\times57.5$) over $m=48\ldots288$ ---
the instrument does not report flatness where flatness is false and manufactures no closure;
the Courant--Fischer direction is violated nowhere ($16/16$ positive-definite cases); the
Dirichlet control (the Hankel half removed, arithmetic kept bit for bit) stops being positive
definite --- $\lambda_1=-5.60\ldots-3.55$ certified on $3/3$ --- so no ceiling exists there:
the reflection half is load-bearing for positivity.
\item \textbf{Prime-front diary T154 (\texttt{green\_align\_probe.py}, contract
\texttt{GREEN.ALIGN}, $29/29$, $5.0$\,s, $12$ prime-power windows $h=50\ldots1077$, verdict
ALIGN-RESISTS, sandbox).} The ceiling half of T153's R2 closes exactly at fixed size
($K^F=1.1019$--$1.9964$ flat, agreement $5.17\times10^{-7}$ on $12/12$); the floor half is
refuted at fixed size ($\|R\|^2/(\beta\lambda_1)=6.3\times10^{3}$--$5.6\times10^{9}$,
$x^{4.50}$) and recovered at full size (one Cholesky per window recovers the whole collapse
price $4.408$--$7.985$; per-window end to end $4.45\times10^{-2}$--$3.13\times10^{-1}$, inside
the target band, while the $m$-free-in-shape number stays
$1.01\times10^{-2}$--$3.92\times10^{-2}$); the obstruction is named (seven bottom directions
agree to $0.15$--$1.35^\circ$ median, \emph{one} sits at $82.93$--$89.79^\circ$) and the
missing fixed-size ingredient is priced (the $L_P$ floor on the Ritz complement,
arithmetic-free, flat $5.93$--$8.25\,\mu^P_1$, worth $91$--$100\%$ of the price); the Kato
route to R1 fails by the same geometry (loss $1.97$--$121$ attained $24.9$--$89.8^\circ$
apart; the Hankel-reflection culprit refuted twice). Two open terms remain (R1$'$/R2$'$, both
uniformity terms); T155 (\texttt{bottom\_floor\_probe.py}) is running at exactly those two
floors. NOT RH evidence; no marker moves.
\item \textbf{Docs + website sync.} \texttt{tfpt\_prime\_front} gains the T154 subsection with
the After-T154 keybox, the \texttt{v551} entry in the verified layer (now seventeen modules),
the phase-2 section retitled T126--T154, the T154 row in the probe index and the updated
counters ($154$ probes, $3951$ checks); \texttt{tfpt\_1}, \texttt{tfpt\_3} and
\texttt{tfpt\_research\_contracts} gain the \texttt{v551} companion blocks;
\texttt{experiments/next.txt} gains the Teil-154 entry;
\texttt{website/lib/primeFront.ts} gains the T154 and \texttt{v551} feed entries; the
prime-front status surfaces move to Teile 11--154 / 3951 checks / 17 modules; suite counter
$544\to545$ scripts. T155 (\texttt{bottom\_floor\_probe.py}) is running at the two uniformity
floors. Ledger row \texttt{PRIME.RITZ.CEIL.01} \mE; \textbf{no marker of any pre-existing
contract moves}.
\end{itemize}


% Original source: changelog.tex:3527-3644 at ba2f0fc; exact block follows.
\subsection*{\interlinepenalty=150\relax 2026-07-29 (V) (\texttt{v550} --- the odd-sector identities of phase 2 promoted; prime-front diary T151 (the one inequality closes by rerouting off the ladder, ODD-CARRIES) + paper + website sync; NO marker moves)}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.5em]
\item \textbf{New module \texttt{v550} (\texttt{PRIME.ODD.SECTOR.IDENT.01}).} Promotion of the
identity/certificate core of the discovery part T151 (\texttt{odd\_ladder\_probe.py}) --- $19$
checks, ${\sim}0.2$\,s, everything recomputed on small frame-A windows, nothing cited from the
sandbox; the companion to \texttt{v549}, which certified the parity compression and the
quadratic ladder certificate $\nu^P_k\le Ck^2$ --- this module certifies the \emph{reroute}
T151 found: off the $\nu$ ladder, through the pencil against the parity Laplacian and one
elementary Sobolev step, to a per-mode bound \emph{linear} in $k$. Scope fence: identities,
per-instance theorems with checked hypotheses and per-window \emph{certified} inequalities ---
no fit, no $D$-exponent, no zone-uniform statement, and explicitly \emph{no statement for all
$D$} (the one open input after T151 --- the $m$-freeness of the bottom pencil ratio
$R=K_{\mathrm{bot}}/\kappa$ for the odd parity sector of a sign-changing-symbol Toeplitz
section --- stays open and typed open). Battery: $12$ frame-A windows ($n=4\ldots139$,
$m=26\ldots285\le300$, $D=7.578\times10^{-3}\ldots2.789\times10^{-2}$), parity control models
at $m=241$ (the certified $(1,1)$ pencil) and $m=2001$ (the $\pi$ price), and a no-go size
ladder $m=64\ldots256$; each statement carries a mutation control that must fail by
$\ge10^{-3}$.
\item \textbf{(1) The grid step-over and the honest negative (T151) \mE.} The parity sines
live on the \emph{shifted} grid $\theta_k=2\pi k/N$, $N=2m{+}1$, which never contains
$\theta=0$, with $\mu^P_k=2-2\cos\theta_k$ \emph{exactly} ($2.2\times10^{-16}$; eigen-residual
$2.3\times10^{-13}$); the symbol has $f(0)=-47.6\ldots-6.3<0$ (T148's honest negative, re-read
and never re-derived) with a nonempty negative window $[0,\theta_c)$, and
$\theta_c/\theta_1=0.371$--$0.485\le0.9$ on \emph{every} window: the odd grid \emph{steps over}
the negative window --- odd-sector positivity is a grid fact, stepped over rather than
cancelled. The honest negative beside it, promoted as content (T150's rest item 3 answered
\emph{negatively}): the symbol-only pencil floor $\kappa_{\mathrm{sym}}(1-\rho)$ is vacuous
($\rho\ge1$) on $12/12$ windows and the symbol moves by $0.45$--$3.27$ relative across
\emph{one} mode spacing --- no pointwise symbol statement is admissible at the bottom mode's
resolution: the local model is a \emph{matrix} statement, not a symbol statement (controls:
the Dirichlet corner breaks the eigenpairs at $1.0$, a one-index shift misses by
$6.5\times10^{-3}$).
\item \textbf{(2) The certified bottom ladder (T151) \mE.} $\lambda_k(A)\le S\mu^P_k$ for
$k\le8$ is certified per window by $8$ completed LDL$^{\mathsf T}$ inertia counts (Sylvester
1852; Bunch--Kaufman 1977 --- a certificate, never a sorted list), $S=1.1019$--$6.4725$: the
odd sector's bottom spectrum \emph{is} the parity-Laplacian ladder up to a printed $O(1)$
factor --- order $2$ in $k$, with no trace of $f(0)<0$ in it (the Rayleigh floor
$L_P\ge\mu^P_1 I$ absorbs it); the count equals the direct spectral count on all $96$
(window, $k$) pairs (control: $S\times10^{-3}$ certifies no eigenvalue below it anywhere).
\item \textbf{(3) The discrete Sobolev step and the $\pi$ price (T151) \mE.}
$\|\nabla\psi\|_2^2=\langle\psi,L_0\psi\rangle-\psi_{\mathrm{last}}^2$ exactly
($7.6\times10^{-15}$), $\|\nabla\psi\|_2^2\le\langle\psi,L_P\psi\rangle$, and
$\|\psi\|_\infty^2\le2\|\psi\|_2\|\nabla\psi\|_2$ on the true window modes, the parity sines
and random unit vectors --- elementary, licensed by the odd sector's virtual node
$\psi_{-1}=0$ (Hardy--Littlewood--P\'olya 1934 / Agmon 1965 the continuum address);
calibration: on the exact parity model the pencil is $(1,1)$ (certified
$|\kappa-1|=1.1\times10^{-12}$ at $m=241$) and the Sobolev per-mode price is $\pi$ to
$5.1\times10^{-8}$ at $m=2001$ --- the honest, $m$-free cost of leaving the $\ell^2$ world
(controls: dropping the boundary term breaks the identity at $4.8\times10^{-2}$, the Neumann
energy undercounts a first-node vector by $0.50$).
\item \textbf{(4) The closed archimedean minimum (T151; T150's rest item 2 closed and
attained) \mE.} The archimedean lag kernel has two shape properties, checked per window and
never assumed --- $c^{\mathrm{arch}}_i<0$ for $i\ge1$ and $c^{\mathrm{arch}}_i$ non-decreasing
on $i\ge1$ --- and given those,
$\min_r\Lambda^{\mathrm{arch}}_r=c^{\mathrm{arch}}_0-c^{\mathrm{arch}}_{M-1}$ \emph{exactly}
(max rel $0.0$; value $2.1719$--$3.4674$), attained at $r=0$: a closed two-term functional of
the smooth kernel, no matrix, no eigenvector, no loss (control: the full atom-including kernel
violates the monotone shape on every window and the closed formula misses its minimum by
$\ge8.7\times10^{-2}$).
\item \textbf{(5) The linear per-mode bound and the no-go discriminator (T151) \mE.} With
$\kappa=0.1939$--$0.3599$ the certified pencil floor (\emph{one} completed Cholesky of
$A-\kappa L_P$ per window, the floating-point floor carried as $\mathrm{fl}/\mu^P_1$; the
direction re-read on the actual bottom eigenvalue) and $K_{\mathrm{bot}}=S$ from item (2), the
chain $b_k:=2m\sqrt{K_{\mathrm{bot}}\mu^P_k/\kappa}\le C_Sk$ holds with
$C_S=12.081$--$26.953\le2\pi\sqrt{K_{\mathrm{bot}}/\kappa}$ on the bottom $8$ modes of every
window --- \emph{linear} in $k$ where the quadratic $\nu$ ladder grew, every $m$-power
cancelled, nothing additive anywhere (the $\Theta(D^3)$ bottom that killed the Weyl /
Bauer--Fike / Davis--Kahan route never enters) --- and the bound dominates the truth
$m\|\psi_k\|_\infty^2$ and the parity Dirichlet energy on every read mode; the bottom pencil
ratio $R=K_{\mathrm{bot}}/\kappa=3.7362$--$18.6607$ is the \emph{one} scalar the chain still
owes, printed per window and typed open in $m$. The discriminator: on the T145 no-go form the
ratio \emph{explodes} on the size ladder ($1.686\times10^{3}\to2.667\times10^{4}$, factor
$15.8$ over $m=64\ldots256$) while the exact parity model holds $R=1$ to $1.1\times10^{-12}$
--- a route that did not fail there would prove a false statement (controls: the ladder
$\times10^{-3}$ fails against the true sups, the inflated floor $1.5\kappa$ makes the Cholesky
\emph{refuse} on $12/12$).
\item \textbf{Fences and status.} Per instance on small windows only --- a finite list of
certified window inequalities with an explicit maximum; nothing uniform in the zone index or
in $D$; the symbol-only route stays certified vacuous; $\mathrm{TV}(\log\Lambda)$ stays
withdrawn as a hypothesis (T149), $\sigma_{\mathrm{tot}}$ stays retired as a route (T148);
every T151 exponent is a fit that stays in the sandbox. Kac--Murdock--Szeg\H{o} 1953, Widom
1958 / Basor--Ehrhardt 2009 / B\"ottcher--Silbermann (the address of the symbol question ---
the computed answer is that the pointwise symbol language does \emph{not} extend to the bottom
mode), Weyl 1912, Parlett, Hardy--Littlewood--P\'olya 1934 / Agmon 1965, Sylvester 1852 /
Bunch--Kaufman 1977, Rayleigh 1877 / Ritz 1909, Cauchy--Schwarz, Wilkinson 1968 / Higham 2002,
Chebyshev 1852 named classical; Weil 1952 cited, never used as a criterion; zero-firewall
AST-checked. Ledger row \texttt{PRIME.ODD.SECTOR.IDENT.01} \mE; \textbf{no marker of any
pre-existing contract moves}, and this is not RH evidence.
\item \textbf{Diary, paper and website (T151, \textsc{odd-carries}).} The T151 probe
(\texttt{odd\_\allowbreak ladder\_\allowbreak probe.py}, contract \texttt{ODD.LADDER},
$27/27$, $43.4$\,s, $72$ prime-power windows $m=96\ldots1491$) closes the one inequality by
rerouting off the ladder: the odd grid steps over the symbol's negative window
($\theta_c/\theta_1=0.328$--$0.407$ on $72/72$), the bottom spectrum is certified against the
parity Laplacian ($\lambda_k\le S\mu^P_k$, $S=1.1019$--$2.3870$), and the discrete Sobolev
step yields the \emph{linear} per-mode bound $b_k\le C_Sk$ with a \emph{non-growing} constant
($C_S=11.5137$--$19.5731$, trend $x^{0.020\pm0.007}$) where the quadratic ladder grew
($13.81\pi$ at $x^{0.258}$); end to end moves to
$2.01\times10^{-2}$--$3.52\times10^{-2}$ of the true gap (gain up to $3.18\times$), the
bottleneck relocating from $Q^\star$ to $\Psi$. Two of T150's three rest items settled: the
minimum of the archimedean diagonal is closed \emph{and attained exactly}
($\min_r\Lambda^{\mathrm{arch}}_r=c^{\mathrm{arch}}_0-c^{\mathrm{arch}}_{M-1}=2.5928$--$4.8981$,
deviation $0.0$), and the symbol route is a computed dead end (the local model is a matrix
statement --- the pointwise symbol language fails at the bottom mode's resolution, margin
vacuous on $72/72$). One scalar remains a fit: the bottom pencil ratio
$R=K_{\mathrm{bot}}/\kappa=3.3634$--$9.7108$ at $x^{0.037\pm0.015}$ --- and the T145 no-go
breaks exactly there ($x^{1.986}$). Verdict \textsc{odd-carries}: all six preregistered gates
met, every layer typed (theorem / certified / elementary-verified), the one fit named.
\texttt{experiments/next.txt} part T151 (series totals $151$ probes / $3852$ checks);
\texttt{tfpt\_prime\_front.tex} gains the T151 subsection with the ``After T151'' keybox, the
\texttt{v550} entry in the verified layer (now sixteen modules), the phase-2 section retitled
T126--T151 and the updated probe index; \texttt{tfpt\_1}, \texttt{tfpt\_3} and
\texttt{tfpt\_research\_contracts} gain the \texttt{v550} companion blocks;
\texttt{website/lib/primeFront.ts} gains the T151 and \texttt{v550} feed entries; suite counter
$543\to544$ scripts. T152 (\texttt{pencil\_ratio\_probe.py}) is running at exactly the
remaining scalar --- the $m$-freeness of the bottom pencil ratio --- and is \emph{not} part of
this change.
\end{itemize}

\subsection*{\interlinepenalty=150\relax 2026-07-29 (IV) (\texttt{v549} --- the gauge/parity identities of phase 2 promoted; prime-front diary T150 (the parity mechanism named, ONE-TERM-MISSING) + paper + website sync; NO marker moves)}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.5em]
\item \textbf{New module \texttt{v549} (\texttt{PRIME.GAUGE.PARITY.IDENT.01}).} Promotion of the
identity/certificate core of the discovery parts T149 (\texttt{weight\_smoothing\_probe.py}) and
T150 (\texttt{mode\_ladder\_probe.py}) --- $21$ checks, ${\sim}0.3$\,s, everything recomputed on
small frame-A windows, nothing cited from the sandbox; the companion to \texttt{v548}, which
certified the factorisation $\Gamma=\sqrt{Q^\star}S_w$ and the Liouville machinery in the Jacobi
gauge --- this module certifies the gauge \emph{freedom} around that machinery and the parity
\emph{structure} underneath it. Scope fence: identities, per-instance theorems with checked
hypotheses and per-window \emph{certified} inequalities --- no fit, no $D$-exponent, no
zone-uniform statement, and explicitly \emph{no statement for all $D$} (the one open input after
T150 --- an $m$-free constant $C$ in the odd-parity-sector ladder $\nu_k\le Ck^2$ for a
sign-changing-symbol Toeplitz section --- stays open and typed open). Battery: $12$ frame-A
windows ($n=4\ldots139$, $m=26\ldots285\le300$,
$D=7.578\times10^{-3}\ldots2.789\times10^{-2}$), $48$ gauge assemblies (Jacobi, const,
moving-geometric-mean, and the arithmetic-free archimedean diagonal), the full-section parity
items on the $6$ windows with $M\le300$, and a parity control model at $m=2001$ (vector
operations only); each statement carries a mutation control that must fail by $\ge10^{-3}$.
\item \textbf{(1) The gauge freedom (T149) \mE.} For \emph{any} positive diagonal
$\tilde\Lambda$ the whitening $\tilde E=\tilde\Lambda^{-1/2}A\tilde\Lambda^{-1/2}$ is an exact
congruence, so $\lambda_{\min}(A)\ge\mathrm{cert}\,\lambda_{\min}(\tilde E)\cdot\min_j
\tilde\Lambda_j$ is a valid certified lower bound for every gauge --- an identity plus one
Rayleigh step --- and the family maximum is valid too (verified on all $48$ assemblies); the
factorisation identity $\Gamma=\sqrt{Q^\star}S_w$ holds \emph{gauge-invariantly} (max rel
$2.4\times10^{-16}$); the const gauge (the geometric mean of the Jacobi diagonal) has
$\mathrm{TV}(\log\tilde\Lambda)=0$ \emph{exactly} on every window --- T149's elimination, not
reduction, of T148's blocking scalar --- with the certified entrywise sandwich
$\sigma=c_2/c_1=1.3868$--$2.5805$ (controls: a $1\%$ $Q^\star$ perturbation breaks the identity
at $4.99\times10^{-3}$, and on the shifted indefinite form $A-1.05\lambda_{\min}I$ the
completed-Cholesky floor \emph{refuses} on $12/12$ windows).
\item \textbf{(2) The two-regime discriminator (T149, the refutation as a check) \mE.} The
flutter-smoothing gauge (moving geometric mean, preregistered half-width $m/16$) removes
$\mathrm{TV}(\log\Lambda)$ by $\ge2.88\times$ on every window while moving the
Liouville-\emph{transported} bottom-block smoothness functional $\nu_{\tilde L}$ by at most
$0.0088$ --- and even the matched-amplitude \emph{rough} re-gauge (lattice-scale oscillation)
moves it by at most $0.0046$ (bar $0.01$ for both): the roughness $\nu_{\tilde L}$ responds to
is \emph{not} in the multiplier --- T149's withdrawal of the TV hypothesis, wired as a
per-instance check (control: the same functional read \emph{without} the transport, on the
whitened modes $\psi$ which carry the multiplier, jumps by $0.41$--$9.76$ under the same rough
re-gauge --- the invariance is carried by the transport, not by numbness of the functional).
\item \textbf{(3) The explicit zone diagonal (T150) \mE.}
$\Lambda_r=c_0-c_{M-1-2r}+\sum_{s\ne r}\max(c_{|r-s|}-c_{M-1-r-s},0)$, assembled lagwise with no
matrix anywhere, equals the lumped-pair diagonal on every window (max rel $5.9\times10^{-16}$)
--- the whitening diagonal is an \emph{explicit} functional of the zone's lag arithmetic and of
nothing else; the lag vector splits \emph{exactly} as $c=c^{\mathrm{arch}}+c^{\mathrm{atom}}$
with $c^{\mathrm{atom}}\le0$ entrywise, and the arithmetic mass carries the closed budget
$\|c^{\mathrm{atom}}\|_1\le\sum_j\mu_j\le4B\sqrt N$ with $B=1.038821$ the \emph{verified}
maximum of $\psi(n)/n$ over the whole atom table (Chebyshev 1852, computed and never assumed;
Abel summation carries the closed form). The honest negative as content: the archimedean
section alone is \emph{indefinite} on $12/12$ windows (completed LDL$^{\mathsf T}$, up to $5$
negative eigenvalues) while the full section has zero --- the atoms are \emph{co-responsible}
for the positivity, so the additive perturbation reading (Weyl 1912 / Bauer--Fike 1960 /
Davis--Kahan 1970, cited, computed dead by T150 at $2.4$--$5.8$ orders, \emph{not} used) is
structurally empty and only the multiplicative / Loewner gauge step transfers (control:
dropping the positive part in the zone formula breaks the identity at $4.25\times10^{-1}$).
\item \textbf{(4) The parity compression (T150, the named mechanism) \mE.} With $U_-$, $U_+$
the antisymmetric / symmetric parity isometries of the full window,
$U_-^{\mathsf T}T_M(c)\,U_-=T-H$ and $U_+^{\mathsf T}T_M(c)\,U_+=T+H$ \emph{exactly} (max rel
$3.9\times10^{-16}$) with cross block $U_+^{\mathsf T}T_MU_-=0$ ($1.4\times10^{-16}$) on all
$6$ windows with $M\le300$: the reflection-odd section used since T106 \emph{is} the
compression of the full symmetric Toeplitz section onto its antisymmetric parity sector
(Basor--Ehrhardt 2009: the parity sectors are the natural objects of the Toeplitz$+$Hankel
algebra, cited as the address and never as an authority); the completed LDL$^{\mathsf T}$
counts \emph{localise} the negative inertia --- the full section's negative eigenvalues
(forced by the sign-changing symbol, $f(0)=-29.2\ldots-6.3<0$; T148's honest negative
\emph{re-read}, never re-derived) sit entirely in the \emph{even} sector while the odd sector
counts zero: $f(0)<0$ is explained rather than worked around (control: the sign-flipped basis
does not reproduce $T-H$, $3.99\times10^{-1}$).
\item \textbf{(5) The parity-sine calibration and the ladder certificate (T150) \mE.} The
parity sines $t_k(r)=\tfrac{2}{\sqrt N}\sin(2\pi k(r{+}1)/N)$, $N=2m{+}1$, are the exact
eigenpairs of the parity Laplacian (reflecting corner $3$, forced by antisymmetry) at
$\mu^P_k=4\sin^2(\pi k/N)$ --- eigen-residual $2.3\times10^{-13}$ --- and the smoothness ladder
\emph{calibrates} on the exact model: $\nu^P_k=\pi k^2$ for $k=1\ldots12$ at $m=2001$ (max
deviation $3.0\times10^{-5}$), so the ladder form $\nu_k\le Ck^2$ is the right question and
$\pi$ its exact floor; on every window, in the const gauge ($\varphi=\psi$ exactly --- the
ladder of the \emph{pure} Toeplitz-minus-Hankel section), the parity coefficient licence holds,
$\nu^P_k\le Ck^2$ with the per-window certified constant $C=11.70$--$17.28$, and the derived
per-mode ceiling $m\|\psi_k\|_\infty^2\le2(2\sqrt Ck+1)^2$ is a certified instance inequality
--- an $m$-free $C$ is exactly the one open input and is \emph{not} claimed (controls: the
ladder $\times10^{-3}$ fails everywhere, a one-index calibration shift misses by $0.75$).
\item \textbf{Fences and status.} Per instance on small windows only --- a finite list of
certified window inequalities with an explicit maximum; nothing uniform in the zone index or in
$D$; $\mathrm{TV}(\log\Lambda)$ stays withdrawn as a hypothesis (T149),
$\sigma_{\mathrm{tot}}$ stays retired as a route (T148); every T149/T150 exponent is a fit that
stays in the sandbox. Kac--Murdock--Szeg\H{o} 1953 (in the parity sector), Widom 1958 /
Basor--Ehrhardt 2009 / B\"ottcher--Silbermann (the parity sectors as the algebra's natural
objects --- the address, never an authority; the sign-changing symbol is exactly what
Basor--Ehrhardt does \emph{not} cover, and that gap is the open input), Sylvester 1852 /
Bunch--Kaufman 1977, Chebyshev 1852 (verified on the table), Abel, Weyl 1912 / Bauer--Fike 1960
/ Davis--Kahan 1970 (cited, computed dead, \emph{not} used), Rayleigh 1877 / Ritz 1909,
Cauchy--Schwarz, Gershgorin 1931, Wilkinson 1968 / Higham 2002 named classical; Weil 1952
cited, never used as a criterion; zero-firewall AST-checked. Ledger row
\texttt{PRIME.GAUGE.PARITY.IDENT.01} \mE; \textbf{no marker of any pre-existing contract
moves}, and this is not RH evidence.
\item \textbf{Diary, paper and website (T150, \textsc{one-term-missing}).} The T150 probe
(\texttt{mode\_\allowbreak ladder\_\allowbreak probe.py}, contract \texttt{MODE.LADDER},
$36/36$, $48.0$\,s, $72$ prime-power windows $m=50\ldots1393$) names the mechanism: the form is
exactly the compression of the full symmetric Toeplitz section onto its antisymmetric parity
sector, and the sign-changing symbol's entire negative inertia sits in the \emph{even} sector
(certified $72/72$) --- T148's honest negative is explained rather than worked around. The
flutter amplitude becomes a certified form functional ($0.0606$--$0.1993$, trend
$x^{-0.165\pm0.015}$, T149's fit reproduced fit-free), the whitening diagonal an explicit zone
functional, and the arithmetic atoms turn out to be co-responsible for the positivity (the
archimedean section alone has $2$--$7$ negative eigenvalues); the additive perturbation route
is dead by $2.4$--$5.8$ orders while the multiplicative gauge step closes. One gate remains:
the ladder constant still grows --- $C\le43.391=13.81\pi$ certified per stratum, trend
$x^{0.258\pm0.009}$ against the flatness bar $0.25$ --- and the gap from $\pi$ is exactly the
arithmetic leakage of the bottom mode ($\ell^1$ mass $1.41$--$1.79$). Verdict
\textsc{one-term-missing}: one named inequality left --- $\nu_k\le Ck^2$ with $m$-free $C$ for
the odd parity sector at a sign-changing symbol.
\texttt{experiments/next.txt} part T150 (series totals $150$ probes / $3825$ checks);
\texttt{tfpt\_prime\_front.tex} gains the T150 subsection with the ``After T150'' keybox, the
\texttt{v549} entry in the verified layer (now fifteen modules), the phase-2 section retitled
T126--T150 and the updated probe index; \texttt{tfpt\_1}, \texttt{tfpt\_3} and
\texttt{tfpt\_research\_contracts} gain the \texttt{v549} companion blocks;
\texttt{website/lib/primeFront.ts} gains the T150 and \texttt{v549} feed entries; suite counter
$542\to543$ scripts. T151 (\texttt{odd\_ladder\_probe.py}) is running at exactly the remaining
inequality --- the odd-sector ladder --- and is \emph{not} part of this change.
\end{itemize}

\subsection*{\interlinepenalty=150\relax 2026-07-29 (III) (\texttt{v548} --- the Green/Szeg\H{o} identities of phase 2 promoted; prime-front diary T148 (lifting statement, ONE-INPUT-MISSING) + paper + website sync; NO marker moves)}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.5em]
\item \textbf{New module \texttt{v548} (\texttt{PRIME.GREEN.SZEGO.IDENT.01}).} Promotion of the
identity/certificate core of the discovery parts T147 (\texttt{green\_asymptotic\_probe.py}) and
T148 (\texttt{szego\_bottom\_probe.py}) --- $21$ checks, ${\sim}0.4$\,s, everything recomputed on
small frame-A windows, nothing cited from the sandbox; the companion to \texttt{v547}, which
certified the a-priori level constant $c_0^{\mathrm{ap}}$ --- this module certifies the two
scalars that constant is made of. Scope fence: identities, per-instance theorems with checked
hypotheses and per-window \emph{certified} inequalities --- no fit, no $D$-exponent, no
zone-uniform statement, and explicitly \emph{no statement for all $D$} (the one open lifting
input --- $\nu_L\le F(\text{form})$ with $F$ $m$-free, equivalently bounded
$\mathrm{TV}(\log\Lambda)$ or any weaker smoothness of the multiplier --- stays open and typed
open). Battery: $12$ frame-A windows ($n=4\ldots139$, $m=26\ldots285\le300$,
$D=7.578\times10^{-3}\ldots2.789\times10^{-2}$), $7$ random positive definite forms for the
form-independent items, and a weight-class model ladder $m=64\ldots288$; each statement carries a
mutation control that must fail by $\ge10^{-3}$.
\item \textbf{(1) The factorisation identity (T147) \mE.}
$\Gamma=\sqrt m\,\lambda_{\mathrm{up}}\max_j\|Re_j\|=\sqrt{Q^\star}\cdot S_w$ with
$S_w=\lambda_{\mathrm{up}}\|R\|_F$ purely spectral and
$Q^\star=m\max_j(R^2)_{jj}/\operatorname{tr}(R^2)$ purely geometric --- \emph{exact} at
$2.2\times10^{-16}$ on all $12$ windows and $7$ random forms: the all-$D$ question splits into
two named scalars and into nothing else; the certified factorisation (residual-paid column norms,
Frobenius bracket) dominates the true $\Gamma$ everywhere ($S_w=1.1186$--$1.5777$,
$Q^\star=2.0879$--$2.8634$; controls: a $1\%$ $Q^\star$ perturbation breaks the identity at
$5.0\times10^{-3}$, perturbing the largest Green column breaks the factorisation).
\item \textbf{(2) The bottom-block equidistribution constant (T147) \mE.} With $\Pi_B$ the
spectral projector onto $B=\{k:\lambda_k\le10\hat\lambda\}$ (preregistered rule, $|B|=3\ldots5$),
$\sum_j(\Pi_B)_{jj}=|B|$ \emph{exactly} ($3.3\times10^{-16}$), hence $Q_B\ge|B|$ is a theorem
(max $\ge$ mean); the \emph{measured} $Q_B/|B|=1.5091$--$1.7980$ lies in the preregistered band
$[1,2.2]$ against the Szeg\H{o}/Widom sharp reference $Q_B\le2|B|$ --- a measurement on a finite
list, typed as such (controls: the rank-$|B|$ coordinate projector gives $Q_B=m$ and overshoots
by $\ge3.9$, a $1\%$ basis scaling breaks the trace identity).
\item \textbf{(3) The second-difference $\ell^1$ ceiling (T148, the lever) \mE.} From the exact
Dirichlet eigenpair $L_0s_k=\mu_ks_k$ and $\mu_k\ge4k^2/(m+1)^2$: the coefficient bound
$|a_k|\le\min(1,\|s_k\|_\infty\|L_0^p\psi\|_1/\mu_k^p)$ for $p=1,2$ against the \emph{true}
coefficients on every window bottom mode and on random unit vectors (worst excess $\le0$), the
$m$-\emph{free} closed form $\|a\|_1\le2\sqrt\nu+1$ with
$\nu=(m+1)^{3/2}\|L_0\psi\|_1/(2\sqrt2)$ --- every power of $m$ cancelled --- and the chain
$m\|\psi\|_\infty^2\le2\|a\|_1^2$; calibration: for the Dirichlet bottom mode $\|a\|_1=1$
\emph{exactly} and $\nu=3.1415\to\pi$ at every size (controls: the ceiling $\times10^{-3}$ fails
on every window, a one-index $\mu$ shift breaks the coefficient identity at $1.5\times10^{-1}$).
\item \textbf{(4) The layer-cake $S_w$ certificate (T148) \mE.} The completed LDL$^{\mathsf T}$
inertia count at every rung of the preregistered ladder
$\tau_i=\rho_i\lambda_{\mathrm{lo}}$ ($\rho=1.5\ldots1024$, $\lambda_{\mathrm{lo}}$ a certified
positive floor) equals the direct spectral count \emph{exactly} on all $96$ (window, rung) pairs
(Sylvester 1852; Bunch--Kaufman 1977 --- a certificate, never a sorted list), and the layer cake
certifies $S_w\le1.3288$--$1.8220$ per window (true $1.1186$--$1.5777$, slack $\le1.216$);
nothing here says $m$-free (control: dropping the bottom layer breaks the bound on every window
--- the bottom eigenvalue is the weight).
\item \textbf{(5) The Liouville transform and the weight-class discriminator (T148) \mE.} The
chain $m\|\psi\|_\infty^2\le\kappa_\Lambda m\|\hat\varphi\|_\infty^2\le
2\kappa_\Lambda\|a(\hat\varphi)\|_1^2\le2\kappa_\Lambda\,\mathrm{ceil}(\hat\varphi)^2$ with
$\varphi=\Lambda^{-1/2}\psi$ (the exact pencil equivalence, a change of variables and not a
perturbation) holds stepwise on every bottom-block mode;
$\kappa_\Lambda=\max\Lambda/\min\Lambda=1.3868$--$2.5805$ is a priori (a ratio of two diagonal
entries of the form). The discriminator: on a model section with a genuine order-2 zero
($f(0)=0$, $f''(0)/2=1$ exact), over the ladder $m=64\ldots288$ at matched $\kappa_\Lambda$
(mismatch $0.0013$), the bounded-variation multiplier keeps $\nu$ flat (max/min $1.003$) while
the rough one ($\mathrm{TV}$ larger by $162.6$) grows by $19.9$ --- the roughness, not the
conditioning (control: the first Liouville step $\times10^{-3}$ fails on every mode, provably ---
the step slack is bounded by $\kappa_\Lambda^2$).
\item \textbf{Fences and status.} Per instance on small windows only --- a finite list of
certified window inequalities with an explicit maximum; nothing uniform in the zone index or in
$D$; the symbol-level order-2 hypothesis is \emph{refuted} (T148: $f(0)<0$ on every surface
window) and enters nowhere as a theorem; $\sigma_{\mathrm{tot}}$ stays retired as a route; every
T147/T148 exponent is a fit that stays in the sandbox. Kac--Murdock--Szeg\H{o} 1953, Widom 1958 /
Basor--Ehrhardt 2009 / B\"ottcher--Silbermann (the mechanism's address, never an authority),
Sylvester 1852 / Bunch--Kaufman 1977, Euler 1735, Rayleigh 1877 / Ritz 1909, Cauchy--Schwarz,
Davis--Kahan 1970 (cited, computed vacuous, \emph{not} used), Gershgorin 1931, Wilkinson 1968 /
Higham 2002 named classical; Weil 1952 cited, never used as a criterion; zero-firewall
AST-checked. Ledger row \texttt{PRIME.GREEN.SZEGO.IDENT.01} \mE; \textbf{no marker of any
pre-existing contract moves}, and this is not RH evidence.
\item \textbf{Diary, paper and website (T148, \textsc{one-input-missing}).} The T148 probe
(\texttt{szego\_\allowbreak bottom\_\allowbreak probe.py}, contract \texttt{SZEGO.BOTTOM},
$31/31$, $13.0$\,s, $48$
windows $m=96\ldots1077$ in four $D$-strata, stress ladders to $m=1500$) dissects the lifting
statement: the second factor $S_w$ \emph{closes} on the surface (LDL$^{\mathsf T}$ layer cake,
$S_w\le1.9587$ certified against true $1.282$--$1.683$, trend flat, per $D$-stratum), at the
price of an honest negative --- the arithmetic Toeplitz symbol has $f(0)<0$ on $48/48$ windows,
so positive definiteness is a finite-section effect of the minus-Hankel part and the lumping and
the KMS order-2 hypothesis survives only as a measurement ($\alpha=1.643$--$1.989$) --- while
the lifting statement resists with its hypothesis isolated to one named scalar
($\mathrm{TV}(\log\Lambda)$, proved to be the roughness and not the conditioning by the
weight-class experiment); the first end-to-end number arrives: the certified chain delivers
$8.36$--$15.86\%$ of the true gap on all $48$ windows (median $11.74\%$), and the
a-priori-shaped chain is still a lower bound at a factor $10.5$. Verdict
\textsc{one-input-missing}: exactly one scalar side ($Q^\star$) lacks an $m$-free certified
statement, target $\nu_L\lesssim34$ against $282$ measured.
\texttt{experiments/next.txt} part T148 (series totals $148$ probes / $3759$ checks);
\texttt{tfpt\_prime\_front.tex} gains the T148 subsection with the ``After T148'' keybox, the
\texttt{v548} entry in the verified layer (now fourteen modules), the phase-2 section retitled
T126--T148 and the updated probe index; \texttt{tfpt\_1}, \texttt{tfpt\_3} and
\texttt{tfpt\_research\_contracts} gain the \texttt{v548} companion blocks;
\texttt{website/lib/primeFront.ts} gains the T148 and \texttt{v548} feed entries; suite counter
$541\to542$ scripts. T149 (\texttt{weight\_smoothing\_probe.py}) is running at exactly the
remaining input --- whether a smoothed whitening removes the TV roughness --- and is \emph{not}
part of this change.
\end{itemize}

\subsection*{\interlinepenalty=150\relax 2026-07-29 (II) (\texttt{v547} --- the level-lemma identities of phase 2 promoted; prime-front diary T146 (level lemma, LEVEL-CARRIES) + website sync; NO marker moves)}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.5em]
\item \textbf{New module \texttt{v547} (\texttt{PRIME.LEVEL.LEMMA.01}).} Promotion of the a-priori
core of the discovery part T146 (\texttt{level\_lemma\_probe.py}) --- $20$ checks, ${\sim}0.4$\,s,
everything recomputed on small frame-A windows, nothing cited from the sandbox; the companion to
\texttt{v546}, whose item (5) certified S1$'$ with a $c_0$ \emph{measured} at the minimiser's own
layer cake --- this module supplies the a-priori side, every factor a functional of the form alone.
Scope fence: identities, per-instance theorems with checked hypotheses and per-window
\emph{certified} inequalities --- no fit, no $D$-exponent, no zone-uniform statement, and explicitly
\emph{no statement for all $D$} (the asymptotic delocalisation of the Green columns, T146's
remainder, stays open and typed open). Battery: $12$ frame-A windows ($n=4\ldots139$,
$m=26\ldots285\le300$, $D=7.578\times10^{-3}\ldots2.789\times10^{-2}$), $9$ random positive definite
forms for the form-independent items, and a stress ladder $m=64\ldots288$; each statement carries a
mutation control that must fail by $\ge10^{-3}$.
\item \textbf{(1) The union identity for nested cakes (T146) \mE.} For a nested decreasing chain
with positive coefficients,
$\sum_{j,l}c_jc_l\,|S_j\cup S_l|=2T\|\psi_t\|_1-\|\psi_t\|^2$ with $T=\sum_jc_j$ and
$\psi_t=\sum_jc_j\mathbf 1_{S_j}$ --- form-independent and $O(m)$, the reason the cake base is
movable at all; exact ($0.0$) against T145's $K\times K$ double sum on all $12$ window minimisers
and $9$ random vectors, \emph{and} against the union sizes computed from the sets themselves with
no nestedness used (controls: one shuffled proper level set $3.2\times10^{-2}$, a $1\%$
perturbation of the heaviest coefficient $4.8\times10^{-3}$).
\item \textbf{(2) The layer-cake counting lemma at a general base (T146) \mE.}
$G(b)\le2b^2\,\|v\|_\infty\|v\|_1/\|v\|^2+\varepsilon(b)$ for \emph{any} vector at all $6$
preregistered bases (margin $\ge1.08$ on the battery and on every window minimiser); at $b=2$ the
leading constant is the classical dyadic $8$ \emph{exactly}, and the base is \emph{free} because
the chain consumes only the lower domination $|v|\le\psi_t$ --- the a-priori constant gains
$4/b_*^2=3.7612$ over base $2$ on every window (controls: the bound $\times10^{-3}$ fails on every
draw and base, and the one-level-down cake breaks the domination on every draw --- the $+1$ in the
cake exponent is load-bearing).
\item \textbf{(3) The resolvent delocalisation bound (T146) \mE.} $\psi=\lambda R\psi$ to
$9.0\times10^{-14}$ --- an \emph{identity}, so no Davis--Kahan transfer step appears anywhere ---
with $\lambda_{\mathrm{up}}=\min_j\mathrm{Rayleigh}(Re_j)\ge\lambda_{\min}$ (Rayleigh--Ritz; window
ratio $1.0592$--$1.2883$), the coordinate bound $|\psi_j|\le\lambda\|Re_j\|$ (Cauchy--Schwarz) and
the column norms certified from above with the linear-solve residual paid for, giving
$\|\psi\|_\infty\le\lambda_{\mathrm{up}}\max_j\|Re_j\|$ on every window (within
$1.061$--$1.337$ of the truth) and $\|\psi\|_1\le\sqrt m\min(1,\Gamma_1)$. The lever: the trivial
ceiling $\max_j\|Re_j\|\le1/\lambda_{\min}$ would give $\Gamma\le\sqrt m=5.1$--$16.9$ (useless);
the certified columns sit a factor $2.85$--$10.17$ \emph{below} it (preregistered bar $2.0$),
giving $\Gamma=1.8356$--$2.2797$ --- read off the form, never off the minimiser (controls: a $1\%$
$\lambda$ perturbation breaks the identity at $1.0\times10^{-2}$, the sup bound $\times10^{-3}$
fails on every window).
\item \textbf{(4) The composite level lemma (T146) \mE.}
$c_0^{\mathrm{ap}}=2b^2\,\Gamma\min(1,\Gamma_1)+\varepsilon=3.9042$--$4.8488$ dominates the
measured level constant on all $12$ windows (slack $1.986$--$2.418$) and stays under the
preregistered ceiling $16=4\times$ Maz'ya's Dirichlet value $4$; the certified window inequality
$\mathrm{cert\_lam\_max}(R)\le c_0^{\mathrm{ap}}\Psi_{\mathrm{abs}}$ holds on $12/12$ (both sides
by completed Cholesky, the density the $|R|$ one with Charikar's cited constant), closing the chain
$\hat\lambda\ge1/(c_0^{\mathrm{ap}}\Psi_{\mathrm{abs}})$,
$\mathrm{gap}\ge\hat\lambda/\kappa_{\mathrm{up}}$ at loss factor $0.0423$--$0.1272$ of the exact
gap. The built-in discriminator: on T145's no-go form $R=aa^{\mathsf T}+\varepsilon I$,
$a_i=i^{-1/2}$, $\Gamma$ grows $3.676\to6.798$ over $m=64\ldots288$ (ratio $1.85\ge$ the
preregistered $1.5$) and $c_0^{\mathrm{ap}}=11.10$ \emph{exceeds} every window value --- the bound
must be worse there, since a candidate that did not fail on the no-go would prove a false statement
--- while the theorem half survives on every no-go size and the Dirichlet path-Laplacian control
stays flat (max/min $1.0063$; control: $c_0^{\mathrm{ap}}\times10^{-3}$ breaks the certificate on
every window).
\item \textbf{Fences and status.} Per instance on small windows only --- a finite list of certified
window inequalities with an explicit maximum; nothing uniform in the zone index or in $D$; only the
sign-free / Green constant is bounded a priori, the energy-route $\sigma_{\mathrm{tot}}$ stays
\emph{measured}, and every T146 exponent is a fit that stays in the sandbox. Maz'ya 1985 (the
strong-type half \emph{not} used as a theorem anywhere), Rayleigh 1877 / Ritz 1909, Cauchy--Schwarz,
Miclo 1999, Davis--Kahan 1970 (cited, deliberately \emph{not} used), Perron--Frobenius (not
applicable to $E$, not used), Fukushima--\=Oshima--Takeda 1994, Charikar 2000, Goldberg 1984,
Gershgorin 1931, Wilkinson 1968 / Higham 2002 named classical; Weil 1952 cited, never used as a
criterion; zero-firewall AST-checked. Ledger row \texttt{PRIME.LEVEL.LEMMA.01} \mE; \textbf{no
marker of any pre-existing contract moves}, and this is not RH evidence.
\item \textbf{Diary, paper and website (T146, \textsc{level-carries}).} The T146 probe
(\texttt{level\_lemma\_probe.py}, contract \texttt{LEVEL.LEMMA}, $30/30$, $7.6$\,s, $64$ windows
$m=26\ldots1173$, $9/9$ preregistered verdict conditions) closes L1 on the measurement surface as
a chain of theorems and certified window inequalities with no step reading the minimiser: four
hand-written profiles lose by $5$--$9$ orders of magnitude, the Green column survives
($\lambda_{\mathrm{up}}/\hat\lambda=1.0497$--$1.3764$), Davis--Kahan is instrumented and discarded
(informative on $0/64$; the spectrum bottom is a near-degenerate block,
$\lambda_2/\hat\lambda=1.2542$--$3.4471$), the cake base proves free (the dyadic $8$ falls to
$2b^2\approx2$, gain $3.76$ at zero cost) and
$c_0^{\mathrm{ap}}=3.9042$--$4.8488$ on $64/64$ windows lands at the size of Maz'ya's classical
Dirichlet value $4$, closing the chain at loss factor $0.0422$--$0.1586$; the one genuine remainder
is $D$-uniformity for \emph{all} $D$ --- the asymptotic delocalisation of the Green columns.
\texttt{experiments/next.txt} part T146 (series totals $146$ probes / $3689$ checks);
\texttt{tfpt\_prime\_front.tex} gains the T146 subsection with the ``After T146'' keybox, the
\texttt{v547} entry in the verified layer (now thirteen modules), the phase-2 section retitled
T126--T146 and the updated probe index; \texttt{tfpt\_1}, \texttt{tfpt\_3} and
\texttt{tfpt\_research\_contracts} gain the \texttt{v547} companion blocks;
\texttt{website/lib/primeFront.ts} gains the T146 and \texttt{v547} feed entries; suite counter
$540\to541$ scripts. T147 (\texttt{green\_asymptotic\_probe.py}) is running at exactly the all-$D$
asymptotics and is \emph{not} part of this change.
\end{itemize}

\subsection*{\interlinepenalty=150\relax 2026-07-29 (I) (\texttt{v546} --- the capacity-chain identities of phase 2 promoted; prime-front diary T145 (Maz'ya proof, ONE-STEP-MISSING) + website sync; NO marker moves)}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.5em]
\item \textbf{New module \texttt{v546} (\texttt{PRIME.CAPCHAIN.IDENT.01}).} Promotion of the
identity-shaped core of the capacity cycle T142 (\texttt{conductance\_profile\_probe.py}), T143
(\texttt{sharp\_capacity\_probe.py}), T144 (\texttt{capacity\_inequality\_probe.py}) and T145
(\texttt{mazya\_proof\_probe.py}) --- $26$ checks, ${\sim}0.5$\,s, everything recomputed on small
frame-A windows, nothing cited from the sandbox. Scope fence: identities, per-instance theorems with
checked hypotheses and per-window \emph{certified} inequalities --- no fit, no $D$-exponent, no
zone-uniform statement, and \emph{no level lemma} (T145's L1 stays open, unclaimed). Battery: $12$
windows ($n=4\ldots139$, $h=26\ldots285\le300$, $D=7.578\times10^{-3}\ldots2.789\times10^{-2}$,
$32$--$5102$ positive off-diagonal edges); the covering kernel is positive definite on $11$, where
items (1)--(2) run; each identity carries a mutation control that must fail by $\ge10^{-3}$.
\item \textbf{(1) The capacity decomposition (T142) \mE.}
$K^{-1}=D^{\mathsf T}J^{-1}D+xx^{\mathsf T}/\mathrm{cap}$ with $J=DKD^{\mathsf T}$ (assembled
entrywise, $3.8\times10^{-15}$), $x=K^{-1}\mathbf 1$ and
$\mathrm{cap}=\mathbf 1^{\mathsf T}K^{-1}\mathbf 1$, as a matrix identity ($1.4\times10^{-13}$);
under the congruence $u=K^{1/2}v$ the Dirichlet half is an \emph{orthogonal projection}
($P^2=P$ at $1.9\times10^{-12}$, $\Omega=\lambda_{\max}(P)=1$ to $5.1\times10^{-12}$ --- the T142
normalisation, where T141 had guessed $20.7$--$2724$), its complement \emph{is} the capacity
rank-one and it annihilates $K^{-1/2}\mathbf 1$ (controls: dropping the rank-one $3.4\times10^{-1}$,
a $1\%$ cap perturbation $3.4\times10^{-3}$).
\item \textbf{(2) The exact capacity--Rayleigh identity (T143) \mE.} With $H=\mathrm{diag}(s)+L_N$
($4.7\times10^{-16}$), $L_N=D^{\mathsf T}BD$ for the signed crossing kernel ($4.9\times10^{-16}$)
and $\rho(W)=1-\lambda_{\min}(A,A_B)$ ($5.4\times10^{-14}$), the assembled quotient
$[d^{\mathsf T}(J^{-1}-B)d+(x^{\mathsf T}v)^2/\mathrm{cap}-\sum_ks_kv_k^2]/[d^{\mathsf T}J^{-1}d+(x^{\mathsf T}v)^2/\mathrm{cap}]$
equals $v^{\mathsf T}(K^{-1}-H)v/v^{\mathsf T}K^{-1}v$ for \emph{every} $v$ ($9.5\times10^{-14}$ on
$24$ random vectors per window), reproduces $1-\rho(W)$ at the exact top eigenvector
($1.7\times10^{-9}$ under the \emph{declared} $1/\mathrm{gap}$ conditioning bar
$5.4\times10^{-8}$), and every random quotient stays $\ge1-\rho(W)$; on the constant vector the
whole denominator \emph{is} the capacity term (controls: dropping it, rel $=1$; the $|N|$ crossing
kernel, $2.6\times10^{-1}$).
\item \textbf{(3) Cholesky nestedness (T144) \mE.} $\mathrm{cap}_E([a,a{+}j))$ equals the prefix sum
of squared forward-substitution entries of \emph{one} triangular solve: $3404$ interval capacities
from $36$ solves at $2.0\times10^{-14}$ against independent Schur solves, exhaustive on the median
window (every prefix, $2.8\times10^{-14}$), monotone in $b$ by construction (control: the reversed
ordering computes \emph{suffix} capacities and deviates by $\ge4.6\times10^{-1}$).
\item \textbf{(4) The whitening certificate (T144) \mE.} $\lambda_{\max}(W)\le\kappa_{\mathrm{up}}$
(completed Cholesky) $\le$ the Gershgorin ceiling on every window
($\kappa_{\mathrm{up}}=1.2245$--$1.4236$ against $\le2.1213$); the licensed chain direction
$\lambda_{\min}(E)/\kappa_{\mathrm{up}}\le\lambda_{\min}(A,A_B)$ holds on every window --- a
denominator comparison, untouched by T142's numerator obstruction --- and the Cholesky refuses at
the shrunken shift $0.995\,\lambda_{\max}(W)$.
\item \textbf{(5) The M4 split and the certified chain (T145) \mE.} The mass half of Maz'ya's step
M4: $\sum_kf_k^2\le\psi^2$ \emph{pointwise} (a theorem for nonnegative truncations, exact slack
$\ge0$), the row-wise implication on rows with $(E\mathbf 1)_i\ge0$, measured mass ratio $\le0.2995$
and the full step $\sigma_{\mathrm{tot}}=0.2197$--$0.4425<1$ on every window although the Markov
hypothesis is absent. Licence 4 is stated with $|R|$ and \emph{not} $R^{+}$, with the witness
$R=[[1,-\tfrac12],[-\tfrac12,1]]$, $x=(1,-1)$ ($3.0>2.0$) built in as a counterexample check. The
sign-free chain is ordered on every window, and S1$'$ is \emph{certified per window on both routes}:
$\mathrm{cert\_lam\_max}(R)\le12\,\sigma_{\mathrm{tot}}\Psi_{\mathrm{pos}}$ (energy,
$c_0=2.6369$--$5.3099$) and $\le G_{\mathrm{dy}}\Psi_{\mathrm{abs}}$ (sign-free,
$c_0=2.5154$--$6.1449$); the better route gives $c_0=2.5154$--$4.2265$ against the classical
Dirichlet value $4$. The all-sets density bound carries Charikar's cited constant, bracketed by
exhaustive enumeration of all $4095$ subsets of a small block (control: $c_0\times10^{-3}$ breaks
the certificate on every window).
\item \textbf{Fences and status.} Per instance on small windows only; nothing uniform in the zone
index or in $D$; the $c_0$ of item (5) is \emph{measured} at the minimiser's own layer cake and the
a-priori level lemma (T145's L1) stays open. Maz'ya 1985 (the strong-type half \emph{not} used as a
theorem anywhere --- it is the thing the cycle transcribes), Muckenhoupt 1972,
Fukushima--\=Oshima--Takeda 1994, Miclo 1999, Charikar 2000, Goldberg 1984, Gershgorin 1931,
Wilkinson 1968 / Higham 2002 named classical; Weil 1952 cited, never used as a criterion;
zero-firewall AST-checked. Ledger row \texttt{PRIME.CAPCHAIN.IDENT.01} \mE; \textbf{no marker of any
pre-existing contract moves}, and this is not RH evidence.
\item \textbf{Diary, paper and website (T145, \textsc{one-step-missing}).} The T145 probe
(\texttt{mazya\_proof\_probe.py}, contract \texttt{MAZYA.PROOF}, $33/33$, $8.0$\,s, $64$ windows
$m=26\ldots1173$) transcribes Maz'ya's classical proof step by step onto the non-Markovian form: M1,
M2, M3 are theorems, the Markov property sits in exactly one line (M4), that line splits, its mass
half is a theorem and dominates ($\sigma_{\mathrm{tot}}=0.215$--$0.443<1$), $c_0$ becomes explicit
($2.248$--$4.227$, fit $D^{0.028\pm0.017}$, zone-uniform) and S1$'$ is certified on $64/64$
windows; an explicit no-go proves a level-profile hypothesis is \emph{necessary}; S2$'$ retired, R5
downgraded, R4 closed --- the mathematical rest is \emph{one} named lemma, L1.
\texttt{experiments/next.txt} part T145 (series totals $145$ probes / $3659$ checks);
\texttt{tfpt\_prime\_front.tex} gains the T145 subsection, the \texttt{v546} entry in the verified
layer (now twelve modules) and the updated probe index; \texttt{website/lib/primeFront.ts} gains the
T145 feed entry; suite counter $539\to540$ scripts. T146 (\texttt{level\_lemma\_probe.py}) is
running at exactly L1 and is \emph{not} part of this change.
\end{itemize}

\subsection*{\interlinepenalty=150\relax 2026-07-28 (III) (\texttt{v545} --- the Hardy-core identities of phase 2 promoted; prime-front diary T140/T141 + website sync; NO marker moves)}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.5em]
\item \textbf{New module \texttt{v545} (\texttt{PRIME.HARDY.IDENT.01}).} Promotion of the identity
blocks of the discovery parts T140 (\texttt{signed\_band\_probe.py}) and T141
(\texttt{discrete\_hardy\_probe.py}) --- $36$ checks, ${\sim}1$\,s, everything recomputed on small
frame-A windows, nothing cited from the sandbox. Scope fence: \emph{identities}, closed-form
quantities and the \emph{validity} --- never the \emph{size} --- of two certified upper-bound
shapes, plus one negative typing. No fit is promoted, no $D$-exponent, no zone-uniform statement,
and no bound that beats the target. Battery: $11$ windows ($n=8\ldots139$, $h=58\ldots285\le300$,
core $m=57\ldots284$, $193$--$5102$ positive off-diagonal edges, $10$--$87$ loaded stripes),
$D=7.578\times10^{-3}\ldots2.388\times10^{-2}$ (a factor $3.15$, so item (8) is a comparison and not
a single point), exact $\rho(W)=0.997759$--$0.999981$; the explicit $n_e\times n_e$ signed Gram is
formed only on the $5$ windows with $n_e\le900$.
\item \textbf{(1)--(3) The form lifting, the exact finite core and the energy reordering \mE.} With
$M$ the edge--interval incidence matrix and $C=\mathrm{diag}(\sqrt\Delta)M$, the T139 telescope
lifts from the \emph{entries} of the signed Gram to its \emph{form}: $\mathrm{Gram}=CHC^{\mathsf T}$
at $3.0\times10^{-15}$, hence $\mathrm{rank}(\mathrm{Gram})\le h-1$ (measured $57$--$183$ against
$193$--$882$ edges; control: unweighted incidence $1.6$). The covering kernel in \emph{closed
geometric form}, $K_{rs}=W([r\wedge s,\,r\vee s])$, equals $M^{\mathsf T}\Delta M$
($1.3\times10^{-15}$) and the spectral radius is an \emph{exact} eigenvalue of the finite core,
$\rho(W)=\lambda_{\max}(K^{1/2}HK^{1/2})=1-\lambda_{\min}(A,A_B)$ ($5.4\times10^{-14}$)
$=\lambda_{\max}(\mathrm{Gram})$ ($7.8\times10^{-16}$) --- three independent routes, no truncation
(control: the factorwise product $\lambda_{\max}(K)\lambda_{\max}(H)$ misses by $7.8\times10^{2}$).
The energy reordering $H=\mathrm{diag}(s)+L_N$ holds at $4.7\times10^{-16}$: a mass term plus a
long-range Dirichlet form, its weights positive on $0.676$--$0.872$ of the off-diagonal area (a
measurement, no law).
\item \textbf{(4) The checkerboard split \mE.} At group length exactly $b$,
$\mathrm{Band}_b=D+A_{\mathrm{even}}+A_{\mathrm{odd}}$ \emph{entrywise} ($0.0$) on all $9$
(window,\,$b$) pairs over $b=4,8,16$, and the resulting three-step Weyl sequence dominates
$\lambda_{\max}(\mathrm{Band}_b)$ with $0$ exceptions (worst ratio $1.6940$) at a step count
independent of the up to $9$ groups --- three steps instead of $O(nb)$ (control: $L=b/2$ loses
entries, $3.5\times10^{-1}$).
\item \textbf{(5)--(6) The four Hardy identities and the closed Muckenhoupt quantity \mE.} (i) the
$K^{+}$ Rayleigh form $\rho(W)=u^{\mathsf T}Hu/u^{\mathsf T}K^{+}u$ at $u=K^{1/2}v$
($6.6\times10^{-13}$); (ii) the signed crossing kernel $L_N=D^{\mathsf T}BD$ with
$B_{kl}=\sum_{r\le k\wedge l,\;k\vee l<s}N_{rs}$ --- the same closed covering formula as $K$, on the
increment grid ($4.9\times10^{-16}$); (iii) $Q=B_+\mathbf 1$ ($1.4\times10^{-15}$): the
Cauchy--Schwarz weight T140 introduced by hand \emph{is} the row sum of $B_+$, so that step is the
Gershgorin diagonal step on $B_+$; (iv) $DKD^{\mathsf T}=L_\Delta$ on the interior nodes
($2.7\times10^{-14}$) with diagonal $(\Delta\mathbf 1)_{k+1}=0.4886$--$15.15$, the endpoint edge
mass --- a \emph{local} quantity and not $\lambda_{\max}(K)$ (control: the crossing kernel of $|N|$
does not reproduce $L_N$, $2.6\times10^{-1}$; the signs are load-bearing). The two-weight quantity
$A_{M0}=\max_kQ_k(\Delta\mathbf 1)_{k+1}$ is computed by two closed routes agreeing to
$8.3\times10^{-15}$; its value ($65.5$--$4244$) is \emph{reported}, its size and zone behaviour are
not promoted (control: $\lambda_{\max}(K)$ in place of the local mass inflates it by $\ge358$).
\item \textbf{(7) Two certified shapes, promoted as \emph{valid} bounds only \mE.} Every Loewner
step is certified by a completed Cholesky ($-1.5\times10^{-14}$, $-2.3\times10^{-10}$). The additive
Hardy chain dominates $\rho(W)$ on $11/11$ windows (factor $3.074$--$10.758$); the exact two-term
Weyl split dominates too ($1.691$--$2.503$) and lies \emph{below} the chain everywhere, so it is the
floor of the whole additive family; the genuinely joint shape $\Lambda(H,Y)\cdot\Omega(Y)$ with a
positive definite Jacobi Hardy form $Y$ dominates on $11/11$ with the closed-form geometric profile
($8.815$--$74.872$ at $\Omega=8.33$--$36.2$) and on $11/11$ with the per-zone tridiagonal read-off of
$K^{+}$. Promoted is the \emph{dominance} on these instances and nothing about the factors.
Controls: the same $Y$ without its mass term is singular --- the constant vector lies in its kernel
($5.7\times10^{-17}$) while $H$ does not vanish there --- so the certificate \emph{refuses} on
$11/11$; and dropping the \emph{positive} part instead of the negative one falls below $\rho(W)$ on
$11/11$.
\item \textbf{(8) The sign-versus-absolute separation --- a negative typing \mX.} Over the measured
$D$ range the exactly bounded object (the signed Dirichlet share) spreads by $1.36\times$, while
every absolute variant spreads by at least $54.94\times$ (Loewner drop $62.03$, Cauchy--Schwarz
$54.94$, product $56.92$), and dropping the positive part of $H$ alone costs
$9.96$--$464.63\times$. The corresponding power laws are \emph{fits} and labelled as fits:
$D^{-0.138\pm0.094}$ (signed) against $D^{-0.776\pm0.352}$ (certified Muckenhoupt) and
$D^{-2.748}$, $D^{-2.820}$, $D^{-2.918}$ (absolute). Promoted is the instance comparison of the
measured spreads, not the exponents.
\item \textbf{Fences and status.} Per instance on small windows only; nothing uniform in the zone
index or in $D$; item (2) is an identity and not a bound, so the zone-uniform discrete Hardy
inequality stays \emph{open}; item (7) promotes validity and not size --- neither shape beats the
target. Abel summation, Cauchy--Schwarz, Weyl 1912, Gershgorin 1931, Haynsworth 1968, Ostrowski
1937 / Fan 1958 / Berman--Plemmons 1979, Muckenhoupt 1972, Bradley 1978, Opic--Kufner 1990, Bennett
1987/1991, Gantmacher--Krein 1950/1960, Karlin 1968, Wilkinson 1968 / Higham 2002 named classical;
Weil 1952 cited, never used as a criterion; zero-firewall AST-checked. Ledger row
\texttt{PRIME.HARDY.IDENT.01} \mE\ $+$ \mX; \textbf{no marker of any pre-existing contract moves},
and this is not RH evidence.
\item \textbf{Diary, paper and website.} \texttt{experiments/next.txt} part T141
(\textsc{hardy-resists}, $22/22$; series totals $141$ probes / $3547$ checks);
\texttt{tfpt\_prime\_front.tex} gains the T141 subsection, the \texttt{v545} entry in the verified
layer and the updated probe index; \texttt{website/lib/primeFront.ts} gains the T141 feed entry and
the \texttt{v545} promotion entry. T142 (\texttt{conductance\_profile\_probe.py}) is running at the
one open ingredient and is \emph{not} part of this change.
\end{itemize}


% Original source: changelog.tex:4113-4231 at ba2f0fc; exact block follows.
\subsection*{\interlinepenalty=150\relax 2026-07-28 (II) (\texttt{v543} + \texttt{v544} --- the lumped $M$-matrix pair and the long-lag support structure promoted; prime-front diary T136/T137 + website sync; NO marker moves)}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.5em]
\item \textbf{New module \texttt{v543} (\texttt{PRIME.MMATRIX.IDENT.01}).} Promotion of the
identity/theorem block of the discovery part T136 ($35$ checks, ${\sim}1$\,s), recomputed on small
frame-A windows --- nothing cited from the sandbox. Scope fence: matrix identities, per-instance
theorems with \emph{checked} hypotheses, and one \emph{negative} per-instance result; no fit, no
$D$-exponent, no uniform-in-zone claim, no floor value. Battery: $20$ seam windows
($n=4\ldots59$, $\rho=1.25\ldots4.00$, $h=25\ldots299$; every factorised or diagonalised matrix
$\le300$) giving $40$ symmetric matrices (pole-free odd sections $+$ border Schur blocks), $39$ with
positive off-diagonals, plus $312$ shifted ladder rungs and $8$ whitened two-grid rungs.
\item \textbf{(1)--(2) The lumped pair and the congruence \mE.} With $\Delta$ the positive
off-diagonal part and $L_\Delta=\mathrm{diag}(\Delta\mathbf 1)-\Delta$, the pair
$A_B=A+L_\Delta$ is Stieltjes (off-diagonals exactly $\le0$), $L_\Delta$ is a graph Laplacian hence
PSD with zero row sums, so $A_B\mathbf 1=A\mathbf 1$ ($1.6\times10^{-15}$) and $A_B\succeq A$ ---
an \emph{upper} bound on $\lambda_{\min}(A)$ and a floor \emph{never} (control: lumping the negative
off-diagonals destroys Stieltjes, $2.0\times10^{-1}$). The congruence
$A=A_B^{1/2}(I-W)A_B^{1/2}$, $W=A_B^{-1/2}L_\Delta A_B^{-1/2}\succeq0$, holds as a \emph{matrix}
identity ($4.4\times10^{-15}$) with $\lambda_{\max}(W)=\rho(L_\Delta A_B^{-1})$
($4.4\times10^{-15}$), and the \emph{declared circularity} $\lambda_{\max}(W)<1\iff A\succ0$ is
checked in \emph{both} directions ($0$ exceptions forward; $39/39$ shifted controls in the
indefinite range give $\lambda_{\max}(W)\ge1$) --- the Loewner sandwich is vacuous by itself, and
that is the content.
\item \textbf{(3)--(4) The anchor and the empty shift ladder \mE.} With $x=A_B^{-1}\mathbf 1\ge0$
and $A_B^{-1}\ge0$ entrywise (Ostrowski 1937, \emph{checked}),
$\lambda_{\min}(A_B)\ge1/\max_r x_r$ on all $39$ rows (min slack $3.0\times10^{-3}$, sharpest ratio
$0.9070$) --- one solve, one sign check, no eigenvalue (control: a positive off-diagonal makes it
false, $1.9000>0.1000$). Lumping commutes with diagonal shifts, $(A-sI)_B=A_B-sI$
($2.5\times10^{-16}$ on $312$ rungs), and $(A_B-sI)^{-1}\ge A_B^{-1}\ge0$ entrywise
(Berman--Plemmons 1979, violation $0$), so $\max_r x_r(s)$ and the a-priori margin
$\|L_\Delta\|_\infty\max_r x_r(s)$ are non-decreasing along the whole ladder: the shifted ladder is
\emph{structurally empty} --- a theorem, not a measurement.
\item \textbf{(5)--(6) Varga's identity and the a-priori Jacobi radius \mE.} For the regular
splitting $A_B=D_0-N_0$ (all three hypotheses checked on $39/39$),
$\rho(J)=\tau/(1+\tau)$ with $\tau=\rho(A_B^{-1}N_0)$ at $4.8\times10^{-15}$
($\rho(J)=0.7347$--$0.9860$); the Collatz--Wielandt bracket at the anchor vector gives
$\min_r(Tx)_r/x_r\le\tau\le\max_r(Tx)_r/x_r$ ($0$ exceptions) and hence an \emph{a-priori}
$\rho(J)\le0.9861<1$ with no eigenvalue anywhere, sharp on the measured gap by
$1.0062$--$1.0531$. Controls: a non-regular splitting breaks the identity
($1.1\times10^{-1}$); at a sign-changing test vector the quotient bound is false on $39/39$.
\item \textbf{(7) The $k$-scanned M18 majorant --- a negative result \mX.} The whitened mass
identity $\|L^{-1}\hat s\|^2=\hat s^{\mathsf T}U^{-1}\hat s$ holds at $7.2\times10^{-16}$ and the
triangle chain is a \emph{valid} majorant at every $k$ separately ($39$ (rung, $k$) pairs over
$k=2\ldots64$, $0$ violations), so the minimum over the ladder is legitimate --- and it does
\emph{not} reach the preregistered T134 bar $1/2$ on any rung (best $3.080$; best over the three
values T134 tried, also $3.080$) while the \emph{measured} bad mass is $\le0.0120$. The
localisation term alone already exceeds the bar ($0.542$): the loss is the bound, and what is
missing is a localisation statement. The bar is \emph{not} moved and nothing is upgraded.
\item \textbf{New module \texttt{v544} (\texttt{PRIME.LONGLAG.SUPP.01}).} Promotion of the
structure block of the discovery part T137 ($24$ checks, ${\sim}0.2$\,s) on the same $20$ windows
($3$--$25$ prime-power atoms, $20555$ positive off-diagonal edges, $455$ loaded stripes, $39$
bracketed lumped comparisons).
\item \textbf{(1)--(4) The support is a comb stripe set, and its amplitude is certified \mE.} The
kernel splits exactly as $c=c_{\mathrm{arch}}-c_{\mathrm{comb}}$ with $c_{\mathrm{comb}}\ge0$, and
the archimedean section alone has \emph{all} off-diagonals $\le0$ on $20/20$ windows: every positive
off-diagonal of $A$ is comb-generated (control: the full section carries $+2.0\times10^{-1}$). Every
one of the $20555$ positive edges has its Hankel index $M-1-r-t$ inside the atom-hat index set ---
per-window fraction exactly $1.000000$ --- so $\mathrm{supp}(\Delta)$ is a union of anti-diagonal
stripes at prime-power atom positions (the converse is reported, \emph{not} claimed). Each stripe is
a perfect matching ($0$ endpoint collisions), so its edge vectors $b_e=e_r-e_t$ are \emph{exactly}
orthogonal and $L_\Delta$ restricted to a stripe is a direct sum of $2\times2$ blocks (control:
edges across two stripes overlap). And $A_{rs}=A^{\mathrm{arch}}_{rs}-c_{\mathrm{comb}}[|r-s|]
+c_{\mathrm{comb}}[\mathrm{anti}]$ gives the amplitude certificate
$\Delta_{rt}\le c_{\mathrm{comb}}[M-1-r-t]$ on all $20555$ edges (excess $-1.9\times10^{-6}$,
sharpest ratio $0.99998532$) --- no eigenvalue, no norm; control: the Toeplitz lag in place of the
Hankel index breaks it on $20415/20555$. Honestly undecided and \emph{not} promoted: at $h\le300$
the hats never overlap, so the tighter one-atom refinement coincides with the certificate here.
\item \textbf{(5) The Green function, bracketed two-sidedly \mE.} For the lumped comparison
$B=D_0-N_0$, $J=D_0^{-1}N_0\ge0$, the anchor identity
$q_J=\max_r(Jx)_r/x_r=1-\min_r 1/(d_rx_r)<1$ ($8.2\times10^{-16}$) needs no measurement; then the
Neumann partial sum to $K=8$ is an \emph{entrywise} lower bound for $B^{-1}$ ($-2.1\times10^{-4}$)
\emph{because the discarded terms are nonnegative}, and partial sum
$+\,(x_r/x_s)q_J^{K+1}/((1-q_J)d_s)$ is an entrywise upper bound ($-1.4\times10^{-1}$), on $39$ rows
($20$ pole-free sections $+$ $19$ border Schur blocks). Control: dropping the tail makes the upper
bound false. This delivers item (2) of the T136 rest list.
\item \textbf{(6) The absolute-value envelope family is certified dead \mX.} With $E=B^{-1}L_\Delta$,
Gershgorin, every row-sum norm and every Collatz--Wielandt quotient at every \emph{positive} weight
are all $\ge\rho(|E|)$, so one rigorous \emph{lower} bound decides the whole family at once: a
Collatz--Wielandt quotient from below at a power-iterated weight gives $\rho(|E|)\ge1.3141\ge1$ on
$20/20$ rows (the cheapest four members all $\ge1.5937$). No member of the family can ever certify
$\lambda_{\max}(W)<1$ --- a certificate of \emph{death}, not a measurement. The \emph{signed}
radius $\rho(E)=\lambda_{\max}(W)\le0.99995781$ on the same rows: the absolute value alone destroys
the cancellation, and what survives is a sign-preserving bound that does not exist yet.
\item \textbf{Named limits as load-bearing content.} Every statement is \emph{per instance on small
windows} --- nothing uniform in the zone index, in $D$ or in the gap. The T136 $D$-exponents (anchor
$D^{-0.565}$, margin gap $D^{+2.72}$, slack $D^{0.116}$) are fits and stay in the sandbox; the
structure bound assembled from the support and amplitude facts does \emph{not} beat the margin (T137:
$0$ of $35$ windows) and is \emph{not} promoted; entrywise positivity of the \emph{target} inverse at
depth stays open. Stieltjes / Ostrowski 1937 / Fan 1958 / Berman--Plemmons 1979 / Varga 1962 /
Frobenius 1912--Perron 1907 / Collatz 1942--Wielandt 1950 / Gershgorin 1931 / Neumann series /
Haynsworth 1968 / Wilkinson 1968--Higham 2002 named classical; Demko--Moss--Smith 1984 cited as a
model and \emph{not} applied (the comparison is dense); Weil 1952 cited, never used as a criterion;
zero-firewall AST-checked; NOT ``almost RH''.
\item \textbf{Diary Teile 136/137 (sandbox).} \texttt{m\_matrix\_pair\_probe.py} (contract
\texttt{M.MATRIX.PAIR}, $30/30$, verdict \textsc{one-carries}): the $\rho(K)$ item closes with
Varga's regular splitting and the Collatz--Wielandt bracket (sharp $1.00$--$1.03$ on $900/900$), the
exact three-way bookkeeping $\lambda_{\min}(A)\sim D^{2.27}=\text{anchor }D^{-0.56}\times
\text{gap }D^{2.72}\times\text{slack }D^{0.12}$ attributes the whole degradation to the margin
(which is only $2.5\times10^{-6}$--$2.5\times10^{-2}$ wide while every cheap bound on $\rho(E)$
sits at $1.82$--$3.11$), and M17 closes \emph{negatively} (the bad pencil subspace is delocalised,
participation ratio $0.54$--$0.98$, its dimension tracking the atom count at
$n_{\mathrm{bad}}/n_{\mathrm{at}}=1.64$ rather than the grid, so $\sigma_b(k)\ge0.646$ everywhere);
promotion list $15\to22$ ready. \texttt{long\_lag\_probe.py} (contract \texttt{LONG.LAG}, $22/22$, verdict
\textsc{both-resist}): $L_\Delta$ is fully comb-generated (the archimedean half has a positive
off-diagonal on $0$ of $40$ windows), the structure bound does \emph{not} beat the margin ($0/35$,
overshoot $24$--$7.1\times10^{5}$ gaps, second differences decaying only algebraically as
$\mathrm{dist}^{-0.63}$ where Demko--Moss--Smith would need a geometric rate), the envelope family
is certified dead from below ($\rho(|E|)\ge1.3218$ on $35/35$), and the Green bracket closes
two-sidedly (lower recovers $0.011$--$0.406$ of the minimum entry, upper overshoots by
$2.49$--$12.24$). Series counter: $137$ probes, $3438/3438$ sandbox checks.
Sandbox only for the probes: no ledger row, no marker move, not RH evidence.
\item \textbf{Ledger/papers/website.} Two new ledger rows:
\texttt{PRIME.\allowbreak MMATRIX.\allowbreak IDENT.01} and
\texttt{PRIME.\allowbreak LONGLAG.\allowbreak SUPP.01}; \texttt{\textbackslash veri} citations in \texttt{tfpt\_1},
