\subsection*{\interlinepenalty=150\relax 2026-07-28 (I) (\texttt{v542} --- the margin-chain identities of phase 2 promoted; \texttt{v379} hardened to an exact positive-mixture Gram certificate; prime-front diary T132/T133 + website sync; NO marker moves)}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.5em]
\item \textbf{New module \texttt{v542} (\texttt{PRIME.MARGIN.IDENT.01}).} Promotion of the
\emph{identity/theorem block} of the discovery parts T128--T131 into one narrow load-bearing module
($44$ checks, ${\sim}0.2$\,s), recomputed on small frame-A windows --- nothing cited from the
sandbox. Scope fence: identities and \emph{per-instance} theorems only; no fit, no graded floor, no
Lanczos value, no uniform-in-zone statement. Battery: $24$ seam instances ($n=3\ldots97$,
$\rho=1.25\ldots4.00$, $h_c=24\ldots214$, $h_f=36\ldots299$; every inverted or diagonalised matrix
$\le300$), $43$ graded/fine grid pairs ($m\le172$) and $400$ randomised profiles; each identity is a
numerical residual against a \emph{preregistered} tolerance plus at least one mutation control that
must fail by $\ge10^{-3}$ relative.
\item \textbf{(1)--(2) Border geometry and the (T) identity \mE.} $\sum_i(1-g_i)=t_l+t_r$ from the
exact interval geometry (max rel $5.5\times10^{-13}$), so the $\kappa$ weights are a probability
vector and the flat border vector gives $\kappa_{\mathrm{flat}}=1$ \emph{exactly} (control: a $1\%$
perturbation of $g_i$ breaks it by $7.9\times10^{-2}$);
$\tau_{\mathrm{dn}}=\|y\|^2-m_{\mathrm{prot}}+m_{\mathrm{fill}}-V_{\mathrm{bord}}$ at
$2.2\times10^{-16}$, with $\tau$ independently recomputed from the \emph{full} odd overlap matrix
($1.1\times10^{-13}$); dropping any of the three correction terms breaks the identity.
\item \textbf{(3)--(4) The profile identity and the curvature chain \mE.}
$p_{N-1}=2-p_0+2E$ at $2.3\times10^{-16}$ (instances) / $1.4\times10^{-15}$ ($400$ random
profiles), hence the equivalence $2E>p_0\iff p_{N-1}>2$ with $0$ exceptions and both branches
realised ($60/400$); the Abel/H\"older chain
$\kappa\le2-p_0+\frac{N-2}{N}\sum_j|\Delta p_j-\overline{\Delta p}|+(p_{\max}-p_{N-1})$ holds per
instance with $0$ violations (min slack $1.0\times10^{-1}$ / $3.7\times10^{-2}$), while the
\emph{same} chain without the curvature term is violated on $88/400$ profiles --- the curvature term
is load-bearing, not decorative.
\item \textbf{(5)--(6) Assembly and the C\'ea/Strang defect \mE.} The matrix-free two-scale assembly
equals $J^{\mathsf T}QJ$ ($5.2\times10^{-16}$) and the graded overlap operator equals $J$
($5.2\times10^{-14}$), reducing to the uniform odd overlap when both partitions are uniform;
$S_{\mathrm{graded}}-S_{\mathrm{uniform}}=R^{\mathsf T}X^{-1}R$ as a \emph{matrix} identity on all
$43$ grids ($2.1\times10^{-14}$) with a PSD defect on every grid, so the compression error is
one-sided \emph{by} the identity (controls: unnormalised merge weights $8.4\times10^{-1}$; dropping
the $-B$ term in $R$ $4.0\times10^{-1}$).
\item \textbf{(7)--(9) Sandwich, Perron implication, counting chain \mE.} The secular sandwich
$\varepsilon/(\|u\|^2+\varepsilon/\mu_1)\le\lambda_{\min}(Q)\le\varepsilon/\|u\|^2$ holds on all
$48$ pole-free sections at which $A>0$ \emph{and} $\varepsilon>0$ are \emph{checked} (relative width
$\le1.4448$), with Albert's sign equivalence verified in \emph{both} directions ($6$ rescaled
controls with $\varepsilon<0$ all give $\lambda_{\min}(Q)<0$); $S^{-1}>0$ entrywise (measured
$48/48$) $\Rightarrow$ sign-constant \emph{and} simple ground vector as an \emph{implication}
(tridiagonal control: hypothesis fails, conclusion fails with it);
$n_{\mathrm{run}}\le n_{\mathrm{cross}}+1\le s_2+2$ and $\sum_j|\Delta p_j-\overline{\Delta p}|=\mathrm{TV}(P)$
with $0$ exceptions on a non-vacuous battery ($s_2$ up to $31$).
\item \textbf{Named limits as load-bearing content.} Every statement is \emph{per instance on small
windows} --- nothing is uniform in the zone index; the $\kappa$ \emph{law} is \emph{not} claimed
(T129 found it false in general), only the chain underneath it; (7) assumes nothing --- positivity
of the pole-free section at depth (the open M25d) is not extended and no floor value is carried;
(8) has a \emph{measured} hypothesis; (6) says nothing about the \emph{size} of the defect (the open
T130 exponent). Abel / H\"older / Schur--Haynsworth 1968 / Albert 1969 / C\'ea 1964--Strang /
Yserentant 1986 / Perron--Frobenius--Ostrowski 1937 named classical; Weil 1952 cited, never used as
a criterion; zero-firewall AST-checked; NOT ``almost RH''.
\item \textbf{Hardening of \texttt{v379} (\texttt{SEAM.S3.RP.01}).} T133 (\textsc{cert.floor})
certified that the $10\times10$ Hankel matrix \texttt{v379} assembles has, \emph{as a
double-precision object}, a negative direction at $-7.75\times10^{-18}$ ($60$ digits) --- inside the
module's old \texttt{min\_eig > -1e-10} tolerance. The mathematical matrix is fine and the exact
rescue is now in the module: the RP Gram is built explicitly as a \emph{positive mixture}
$M=V^{\mathsf T}\mathrm{diag}(1/1600)V$, $V_{ki}=e^{-\varepsilon_k\tau_i}$, so
$x^{\mathsf T}Mx=\sum_k w_k(v_k\!\cdot\!x)^2$ is a \emph{sum of squares} and $M\succeq0$ holds
exactly; the mixture identity is zero at the rounding level ($1.1\times10^{-15}\le64u|M|$) and the
sum-of-squares route is nonnegative on $510/510$ test directions where the assembled float form is
negative on $2$. The eigenvalue check is \emph{retained and relabelled a diagnostic measurement}.
Ledger row \texttt{SEAM.S3.RP.01} reworded accordingly (method text: exact positive-mixture Gram
identity, eigenvalue check as diagnostic); \textbf{marker stays \mE\ --- no upgrade}. $7$ checks
(was $5$), \texttt{run\_all} green.
\item \textbf{Diary Teile 132/133 (sandbox).} \texttt{bd\_seam\_probe.py} (contract
\texttt{BD.SEAM}, $21/21$, verdict \textsc{spectrum-only}): the model boundary-Dirac and the marks
kernel share their spectrum to $7.5\times10^{-13}$ but are \emph{not} the same operator --- the gap
sits in the killing mass $0.1746$ ($N$-stable), the killing measure equals the marks profile
pointwise, the Markov remainder is exactly zero with a closed jump-weight form (odd lags positive,
even lags zero --- which explains T126's $86.1\%$), and the $D_4$ lattice symmetries leave the triad
exactly invariant; ceiling: the DtN is a model DtN, the gate is \emph{not} closed.
\texttt{cert\_floor\_probe.py} (contract \texttt{CERT.FLOOR}, $23/23$, verdict \textsc{mixed}, $840$
control validations): the \texttt{v379} finding above plus a recommendation table --- the hardening
is implemented in this same change. Series counter: $133$ probes, $3352/3352$ sandbox checks.
Sandbox only: no ledger row for the probes, no marker move, not RH evidence.
\item \textbf{Ledger/papers/website.} New ledger row \texttt{PRIME.MARGIN.IDENT.01};
\texttt{\textbackslash veri} citations in \texttt{tfpt\_1}, \texttt{tfpt\_3},
\texttt{tfpt\_research\_contracts} and the promotion place of \texttt{tfpt\_prime\_front} (verified
layer now \emph{eight} modules; phase 2 extended to T126--T133); website mirrors
(\texttt{/prime-front} feed entries T132/T133, status surfaces Teile 11--133 / $3352$ checks,

\end{itemize}

\subsection*{\interlinepenalty=150\relax 2026-07-27 (IV) (prime front: T111 deep ladder maps three walls, crossing measured at $n\approx462$ --- CROSSING-CONFIRMED; paper + diary + website sync; NO marker moves)}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.5em]
\item \textbf{Diary Teil 111 (sandbox).} \texttt{experiments/tfpt-discovery/deep\_zone\_stress\_probe.py}
(contract \texttt{DEEP.ZONE.STRESS}, $23/23$ checks, $140$\,s, verdict \textsc{crossing-confirmed}):
the probe stops extrapolating and measures --- the T110 grid is reproduced bit-exactly, then the
ladder is extended to every prime-power zone $n\le1000$ plus a thin tail to $3001$ ($199$ zones;
chain ladder $n=2\ldots521$ with $117$ handovers). The ratio $m_k/\mathrm{need109}$ falls
$179.59\to0.0174$; the crossing is \emph{measured}: last zone $\ge1$ at $n=461$, first below at
$n=463$ ($0.935$) --- T110's $n\approx170$ was a fit artefact, but the wall is real, and a
depth-preserving resolution study makes $n^*\approx462$ an \emph{upper} bound. The failure follows
the prime branch (prime powers $512/529/625/729$ survive longer). New and harder: the \emph{ladder
wall} --- the nested step needs a lag gap $>2D$, and the twin-prime pair $521\to523$ (gap
$0.003831<2D=0.005617$) kills the ladder arithmetically (arithmetic scan to $40\,000$: $4052/4284$
pairs endangered; co-moving $D\sim1/n$ forces $h\sim n\log n/4$). The no-reserve finding softens
($f_{\mathrm{crit}}\sim n^{-0.39}$, the reserve opens with depth); the circle breaks first at
$k=109$, $n=463$ --- it tears at the ratio, not at a step: all $117$ handovers certify at retention
$1.000000$ (largest single loss $5.96\times10^{-8}$), atom entry free $117/117$. Three separate
walls: margin $n\approx462$ (measured), ladder $521\to523$ (twin primes), requirement $n=727$
($\omega_{\mathrm{cert}}\ge1$, $\mathrm{need109}$ vacuous on $46$ zones). Reinterpretation: the
operating variable is the window \emph{depth}, not $n$ (cheek doubling moves the wall $463\to47$);
a proof must beat the exponent gap $-0.974=-0.681-0.293$ and couple $\delta_0$ to the local prime
gap. Follow-up probe T112 (\texttt{adaptive\_scaling\_probe.py}, contract \texttt{ADAPTIVE.SCALING},
the $n$-adaptively scaled frame) is running. Series counter: $111$ probes, $2781/2781$ sandbox
checks. Sandbox only: no ledger row, no marker move, not RH evidence.
\item \textbf{Paper \texttt{tfpt\_prime\_front}.} Certification-arc section extended to T102--T111
(new subsection ``The three walls (T111)''); the T110 three-gaps box and the $n\approx170$ mentions
corrected to the measured $n^*\approx462$ (fit artefact noted); reduction-cascade caption, two-doors
figure chain, three-way status split and asymptotic-mountain section updated (the three walls as
the measured formulation; depth-not-$n$ reinterpretation; T112 running); abstract and probe-index
appendix updated (T111 row; series counter $111$/$2781$; T112 recorded as running and deliberately
absent).
\item \textbf{Website.} \texttt{/prime-front}: T111 feed entry (\texttt{lib/primeFront.ts}, new
verdict enum \textsc{crossing-confirmed}), status line in the two-doors convergence panel (T111 +
T112 running), hero counter Teile 11--111 / $2781$ sandbox checks, program-status callout sentence
for T111.
\end{itemize}

\subsection*{\interlinepenalty=150\relax 2026-07-27 (I) (new companion \texttt{tfpt\_prime\_front} --- the prime / zeta line documented end to end as RESEARCH DOCUMENTATION; NO new claims, NO marker moves)}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.5em]
\item \textbf{New companion paper \texttt{tfpt\_prime\_front} (P).} $22$ pages, $9$ sections plus two
appendices, $8$ TikZ figures. It documents the complete prime / zeta line of the project from the first
$\mu_4\Rightarrow\chi_4$ observation to the current residual --- explicitly a \emph{documentation of a
research route}, not a results paper. Registered in \texttt{tex-artefacts/tfpt\_docset.tex} as the fifth
companion.
\item \textbf{Framework interpretation stated once, up front.} Section~3, ``The big picture'', collects
the reading that motivated the line and labels it as interpretation: the $E_8$ shell count
$N(2n)=240\sigma_3(n)$ is the Dirichlet series $240\,\zeta(s)\zeta(s-3)$; the $\mu_4$ glue carries
$\chi_{-4}$, so the $4k{+}1$ / $4k{+}3$ split is a fibre property of the compiler and the signed channel
is the only pole-free one; Hecke structure is emitted by lattice adjacency (\vref{v535}) rather than put
in; $E_8$ is unimodular, so Poisson summation gives the theta sum an exact functional equation whose
fixed axis is the critical line --- the same reflection that reappears as $J_1\circ J_{1/2}=e^{\pm u}$
(the transport operator, T83) and as the parity split of the Weil pole (T106). Explicitly typed as a
picture, not a reformulation, and not used as a premise anywhere.
\item \textbf{Verified layer restated, not extended.} Sections~4.1--4.7 restate the seven load-bearing
modules \vref{v535}--\vref{v541} with their ledger status markers quoted verbatim (Hecke from geometry,
Eichler trace layer, half-integral bridge, relative-trace identity, Weil structure family, amplitude
linear carrier, matching-lemma / transport ledger). The \texttt{\textbackslash veri} citations in this
paper are the only citations it makes; no ledger row is added, moved or upgraded.
\item \textbf{Sandbox layer marked as sandbox throughout.} The localization program (I5, the
Connes--Consani dictionary, the tightness map, the Sonin crossing, the blind prime demo), the handover
induction and the certification arc are carried as clearly tagged \emph{sandbox} content with a
per-section provenance marker; every quantitative statement carries its probe label (T$n$) and is
reproduced verbatim from the research diary. All measured quantities are declared as measured, all
window results as window results, all hypothesis inputs as hypothesis inputs.
\item \textbf{Kill list as a first-class section.} Section~8 records the refuted readings and dead
routes of the program (essential-singularity reading, the $C/g$ proxy law, the naive margin route, the
density chain, the Landau--Widom anchor, the accumulated invariant with self-propagation, the symbol
route for the odd channel, three certificate candidates for the avoidance norm), each with the probe
that killed it.
\item \textbf{Explicit RH fence.} The paper states in the abstract, in the scope-and-status statement, in the
reduction figure and in the status section that \emph{no progress on the Riemann Hypothesis is claimed};
the I5 $\Leftrightarrow$ Weil positivity $\Leftrightarrow$ RH relation is carried, as in the ledger, as an
equivalence \emph{typing} only. \texttt{ZETA.HP.CARRIER} untouched.
\item \textbf{Appendices.} Probe index T11--T108 ($98$ parts, $99$ runs, $2509$ green checks; the
diary's own series counter at T108 reads $108$ probes / $2701$ checks including the ten parts that
predate the current diary file) with contract, verdict and check count per probe, plus a symbol table
for the sandbox objects used in the figures. T109 (\texttt{boundary\_decay\_probe.py}) was running when
the document was written and is deliberately absent.
\end{itemize}

\subsection*{\interlinepenalty=150\relax 2026-07-25 (XVIII) (\texttt{v540} --- amplitude route and positive linear carrier: open boundary $\lambda^*$ as content; NO marker moves)}

$D=\bigl(\begin{smallmatrix}0&V\\V^{\mathsf T}&0\end{smallmatrix}\bigr)$ with
$V[d,m]=\sqrt{w_d}\,b(d)\chi_d(m)$: $D=D^{\mathsf T}$;
$D^2=\operatorname{diag}(VV^{\mathsf T},K)$, $V^{\mathsf T}V=K$ (rel $2.7\times10^{-16}$);

lattice-exact; $N_\pm\ge0$ and $b^2=\Theta^2-4N_+N_-$ for all $n\le50000$; $\Theta$ is a
\emph{pure} Siegel--Weil Eisenstein $\sigma_3$-eigenform ($p\le13$, cusp component zero);
Cohen seed $\Theta(d)=-48\,L(-1,\chi_d)$ exact-rational on $159$ live $d$.

$\mu=48\,|L(-1,\chi_d)|\,|d|^{-a}$: full weights $\lambda_k=1+p^{3k}-(\chi p)^k$

$\Lambda_\Theta(s)=8^{1-s}\Lambda_{\Theta^\dagger}(5/2-s)$ in the strip (rel $1.4\times10^{-40}$,
independent split points); poles $5/2$ / $0$ swapped; centre $5/4$, plus-locus offset exactly $1/4$.

FE-self-dual, gap functional $\lambda^*$ FE-covariant ($36/36$ sampled); mirror sign law

\begin{itemize}

each ramified at its prime. \mE\ the QG susceptibility is pure $\{2,3\}$: $\chi=1/(1{-}(2/3)^6)=729/665=3^6/(3^6{-}2^6)$,

attractors.

prime-2-as-common-factor reading \emph{forced} (the seam involution provably in every sector's gap, no independent

\subsection*{2026-06-17 (Experiments: black-hole-cosmology signatures, the $\eta_B$ Boltzmann solve, the Petz/baby-universe realisation, and a real-data GW-echo pipeline)}
\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{Three new standalone black-hole-cosmology experiments (\texttt{experiments/}, all
  \texttt{data\_limited}, not load-bearing).} From the \texttt{problem\_b} black-hole-cosmology survey:
  (i) \texttt{ccbh-dark-energy} --- the de~Sitter seam interior ($w_{\mathrm{in}}{=}{-}1$) forces the
  Croker--Weiner cosmological-coupling index $k={-}3w_{\mathrm{in}}=3$, hence a population $w={-}1$;
  vs.\ Farrah+2023 $k=3.11\pm0.79$ ($-0.14\sigma$), a \emph{contested} downstream bridge and an
  \emph{alternative reading} of the same $w={-}1$ the DESI watchdog tests (\texttt{alternative\_group}
  \texttt{w\_de\_eos}, never double-counted). (ii) \texttt{gravastar-compactness} --- the Nariai
  $Q_{\mathrm{geom}}{=}3/8$ equals the Jampolski--Rezzolla (2026) maximum horizonless compactness
  $\mathcal C{=}3/8$ (shared de~Sitter endpoint $1/2$); since $1/3{<}3/8{<}4/9{<}1/2$ this is a
  light-trapping ECO, yielding an echo template (round-trip delay ${\sim}0.7$ ms at $62\,M_\odot$,
  amplitude $\le(2/3)^6$) --- a \mC\ structural echo, no $\mathcal C\!\leftrightarrow\!Q_{\mathrm{geom}}$
  map proven. (iii) \texttt{cosmic-handedness} --- a parity watchdog (Shamir JADES ${\sim}3.3\sigma$
  spin monopole, most likely a Milky-Way-aberration dipole), explicitly \emph{not} promoted (frontier).
\item \textbf{$\eta_B$ --- full BDP Boltzmann ODE solve confirms the route at the frozen scale
  (\texttt{experiments/ftransfer/leptogenesis\_boltzmann/fboltzmann\_solve.py}; \texttt{tfpt\_4\_frontier},
  \mC).} Integrating the Buchm\"uller--Di~Bari--Pl\"umacher Boltzmann network (integrated efficiency
  $\kappa_f=0.092$, validating the analytic fit) at the \emph{frozen} heavy scale
  $M_1=M_{\mathrm{scal}}(\phiz)^2/A_\Lambda\approx8.65\times10^9$ GeV with $\delta_{\mathrm{CP}}=4\pi/3$ gives
  $\eta_B=6.5\times10^{-10}$ --- a factor $1.07$ from the observed $6.1\times10^{-10}$, with \emph{no} free
  $M_R$ dial. This moves the leptogenesis route from ``solve pending'' to a consistent \mC\ readout (the full
  \emph{flavored} density-matrix solve is the next refinement); \texttt{tfpt\_4\_frontier} Route~C synced.
\item \textbf{The Petz recovery map and the rank-one baby universe, realised numerically
  (\texttt{experiments/recovery-channel}; \texttt{tfpt\_horizon\_readouts}, \mC; companion to \vref{v221}).}
  The gapped transport contracts to a \emph{rank-one} projector at exactly $\|T^n-P_\infty\|=(2/3)^{6n}$ ---
  the one-dimensional baby-universe Hilbert space (Engelhardt 2025) --- and the explicit Petz map is CPTP,
  recovers the reference, and equals the identity only on the protected $\lambda{=}1$ (Knill--Laflamme) mode;
  free-ratio and degenerate-spectrum negative controls hold. So the Petz identification \vref{v221} deferred is
  now verified at the channel level (\texttt{internal\_consistency}, no new datum); the full holographic
  reading stays gated on the Seam--Horizon theorem.
\item \textbf{GW ringdown echo --- Stage-1 matched filter validated, then run on real GWOSC strain
  (\texttt{experiments/gw-ringdown-echo}; \texttt{tfpt\_horizon\_readouts} search-targets).} The Stage-1
  machinery (Kerr-ringdown subtraction $\to$ matched filter on the residual, ratio $(2/3)^6$ frozen, lag free,
  $+$ free-ratio control) classifies $3/3$ synthetic injections; run on \emph{real} GWOSC strain
  (GW150914, GW190521; PSD-whitening $+$ off-source background): \textbf{no kernel-ratio echo coincident in
  $\ge2$ detectors}, consistent with the $(2/3)^6$ \emph{upper} bound (a single loud H1 excess has
  $\hat q\approx2$, far from $(2/3)^6$, so the free-ratio control flags it as residual ringdown, not an echo).
  First pass: dominant-QNM subtraction, incoherent combination --- full multi-mode $+$ coherent stacking is the
  next step; no detection claim.
\item \textbf{Scorecard + website synced.} \texttt{experiments/evidence\_scorecard.json} now $51$ rows
  ($26$ consistent, $7$ null, $13$ data-limited, $4$ tension, $1$ parked); the website
